content.cn: 对于与梨状肌相关的坐骨神经压迫，读者发现，将局部外用的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与CBD油和蓖麻油，或与薄荷油和利多卡因混合使用，可以缓解疼痛。 <sup data-ref="355">355</sup> <sup data-ref="355">355</sup> <sup data-ref="356">356</sup> 多份报告显示，肩部滑囊炎（一种常见的撞击综合征相关压迫症）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有良好反应。其中一位读者曾表示，他的医生和物理治疗师“试图强迫我接受一种让我难以接受的治疗”，但发现使用二甲基亚砜混合物治疗一个月后， 对于伴有滑囊炎和颈部神经受压的肩周炎而言，简直是“奇迹”。 <sup data-ref="355">355</sup> 注：肩部滑囊炎是二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最早被认可可治疗的病症之一，因此，大量研究（以及读者报告 <sup data-ref="355">355</sup> <sup data-ref="355">355</sup> <sup data-ref="356">356</sup> <sup data-ref="357">357</sup> <sup data-ref="358">358</sup> <sup data-ref="359">359</sup> <sup data-ref="360">360</sup> <sup data-ref="361">361</sup> <sup data-ref="362">362</sup> <sup data-ref="363">363</sup> <sup data-ref="364">364</sup> <sup data-ref="365">365</sup> <sup data-ref="366">366</sup> <sup data-ref="367">367</sup> <sup data-ref="368">368</sup> ）均证实了这一点。 同样，读者们也报告了其他滑囊炎症状的显著改善（最常见的是髋部，但也包括膝盖等其他部位，如 <sup>foot).</sup> <sup data-ref="355">355</sup> <sup data-ref="355">355</sup> <sup data-ref="356">356</sup> <sup data-ref="357">357</sup> <sup data-ref="358">358</sup> <sup data-ref="359">359</sup> <sup data-ref="360">360</sup> <sup data-ref="361">361</sup> <sup data-ref="362">362</sup> <sup data-ref="363">363</sup> <sup data-ref="364">364</sup> <sup data-ref="365">365</sup> <sup data-ref="366">366</sup> <sup data-ref="367">367</sup> <sup data-ref="368">368</sup> <sup data-ref="369">369</sup> <sup data-ref="370">370</sup> <sup data-ref="371">371</sup> <sup data-ref="372">372</sup> <sup data-ref="331">331</sup> <sup data-ref="373">373</sup> <sup data-ref="374">374</sup> <sup data-ref="375">375</sup> <sup data-ref="376">376</sup>

content.en: [DMSO has also been used](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=49841417) for leprosy neuritis (in the hypertrophic form), where 25% DMSO mixed with lidase was applied via magnetophoresis as part of comprehensive physiotherapy aimed at reducing pain, inflammation, and fibrosis, and improving nerve conduction (while separately DMSO combinations also healed nerves damaged by leprosy <sup data-ref="175">175</sup>). A [clay-based balm (Kavalgin)](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Aram-Mikaelyan/publication/370596637_APPLICATION_PERSPECTIVES_OF_THE_AVAN_SALT_MINE'S_BOTTOM_SEDIMENT'S_HIGHLY_MINERALIZED_CLAY_IN_MEDICINAL_CLAYS_AND_COSMETOLOGY/links/664252da08aa54017a070b8b/APPLICATION-PERSPECTIVES-OF-THE-AVAN-SALT-MINES-BOTTOM-SEDIMENTS-HIGHLY-MINERALIZED-CLAY-IN-MEDICINAL-CLAYS-AND-COSMETOLOGY.pdf) incorporating DMSO as a penetration enhancer alongside propolis and laurel essential oil was patented for treating neuritis, neuralgia, osteochondrosis, and sciatica.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还被用于治疗麻风性神经炎（增生型），具体做法是将25%的DMSO与利达酶混合，通过磁电透皮给药法进行治疗，作为旨在减轻疼痛、炎症和纤维化并改善神经传导的综合物理疗法的一部分（此外，DMSO的各种复方制剂也能修复因麻风病受损的神经 <sup data-ref="175">175</sup> ）。 一种以粘土为基底的药膏（Kavalgin），其中将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）作为渗透增强剂，并配合蜂胶和月桂精油，已获得专利，用于治疗神经炎、神经痛、骨关节病和坐骨神经痛。

content.en: Autoimmune Neuritis
content.cn: 自身免疫性神经炎

content.en: In experimental autoimmune neuritis (EAN, an animal model of Guillain-Barré syndrome), a prostaglandin E2-EP4 receptor antagonist (L-161982) dissolved in DMSO repeatedly delayed disease onset, reduced peak clinical scores, decreased inflammatory cell infiltration (IFN-γ, IL-17, TNF-α, IL-6), suppressed lymphocyte proliferation, and reduced chemokine expression (CXCL-12, MCP-1) in sciatic nerves, with immunization-phase treatment superior to onset-phase treatment.<sup data-ref="377">377</sup>, <sup data-ref="378">378</sup>, <sup data-ref="379">379</sup>, <sup data-ref="380">380</sup> Notably, in [a study of 11 patients](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8957021/) with IgM monoclonal gammopathy-associated demyelinating polyneuropathy, the sole individual lacking detectable anti-myelin autoantibodies was the one previously treated with DMSO.
content.cn: 在实验性自身免疫性神经炎（EAN，一种吉兰-巴雷综合征的动物模型）中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的前列腺素E2-EP4受体拮抗剂（L-161982）多次推迟了疾病发作，降低了临床评分峰值，减少了坐骨神经中的炎性细胞浸润（IFN-γ、 IL-17、TNF-α、IL-6），抑制了淋巴细胞增殖，并降低了坐骨神经中趋化因子的表达（CXCL-12、MCP-1），其中免疫阶段的治疗效果优于发病阶段的治疗。 <sup data-ref="377">377</sup> <sup data-ref="378">378</sup> <sup data-ref="379">379</sup> <sup data-ref="380">380</sup> 值得注意的是，在一项针对11例IgM单克隆γ球蛋白血症相关脱髓鞘性多发性神经病患者的研究中，唯一一名未检测到抗髓鞘自身抗体的患者正是此前接受过二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗的患者。

content.en: Additionally, DMSO has been repeatedly shown to address encephalitis and encephalomyelitis from a variety of causes including autoimmunity (detailed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms)), with one reader reporting it cured an incurable case,<sup data-ref="381">381</sup> while [one reader with Morvan’s syndrome](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/152884648), a rare and severe autoimmune channelopathy (that developed following viral encephalitis) reported that after two weeks of topical 70% DMSO cream, inflammation in his hands visibly decreased and pain was reduced by 75%. His case was particularly severe, having required multiple nerve decompression surgeries, four joint replacements, cervical fusion, and two nerve stimulator implants.
content.cn: 此外，已有多次研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可治疗由多种原因（包括自身免疫性疾病，详见此处）引起的脑炎和脑脊髓炎，其中一位读者报告称它治愈了一例被认为无法治愈的病例， <sup data-ref="381">381</sup> 另一位患有莫尔万综合征（一种罕见且严重的自身免疫性离子通道病，由病毒性脑炎引发）的读者则表示，在连续两周外用70%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）乳膏后，其手部炎症明显减轻，疼痛减轻了75%。他的病情尤为严重，此前曾接受过多次神经减压手术、四次关节置换术、颈椎融合术以及两次神经刺激器植入手术。

content.en: Myasthenia Gravis
content.cn: 重症肌无力

content.en: In order for skeletal muscles to fire, they need to receive acetylcholine from the nerve that directs them. In myasthenia gravis (MG) the body forms antibodies to the muscle’s acetylcholine receptors (AChRs), and as they are destroyed, the muscles need more and more acetylcholine to be sent by the nerves to activate. MG is hence managed by various immune-suppressing medications, filtering the AChR antibodies out of the blood, and acetylcholine esterase inhibitors (which boost acetylcholine levels)—suggesting DMSO’s anti-inflammatory and AChR-augmenting properties (via [acetylcholine esterase inhibition](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for)) may benefit the disease.
content.cn: 骨骼肌要收缩，就需要从控制它们的神经中接收乙酰胆碱。在重症肌无力（MG）中，人体会产生针对肌肉乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）的抗体，随着这些受体被破坏，肌肉需要神经传递越来越多的乙酰胆碱才能被激活。 因此，重症肌无力通常通过多种免疫抑制药物、从血液中过滤出AChR抗体以及乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂（可提高乙酰胆碱水平）来治疗——这表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的抗炎特性及其增强AChR功能的特性（通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶）可能对该疾病的治疗有益。

content.en: DMSO’s potential for MG [was initially discovered](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7453805/) (accidentally) in 1980, when two researchers tested a variety of agents for their ability to reduce AChR antibodies, and realized that the DMSO being used as a vehicle for the various agents they were testing was independently reducing those antibodies. They then found that giving rats daily intraperitoneal injections of 1 mL DMSO for two weeks resulted in a 52% decrease in AChR antibodies (but not total IgG levels) that persisted for an additional six weeks after treatment was terminated.<sup data-ref="382">382</sup>, <sup data-ref="383">383</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在肌无力症（MG）治疗中的潜在作用最初于1980年（偶然）被发现。当时，两名研究人员在测试多种药物降低乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体水平的能力时，发现作为这些测试药物载体的二甲基亚砜，本身也在独立地降低这些抗体水平。 随后他们发现，大鼠每日腹腔注射1毫升DMSO并持续两周后，乙酰胆碱受体抗体水平下降了52%（但总IgG水平未受影响），且该效果在停药后仍持续了六周。 <sup data-ref="382">382</sup> <sup data-ref="383">383</sup>

content.en: *Note: after this discovery, the researchers expressed their eagerness to test DMSO in humans with MG ([the New York Times even covered it](https://www.nytimes.com/1981/01/15/us/scientists-seek-to-test-controversial-solvent-on-disease-of-muscles.html)).
content.cn: 注：这一发现公布后，研究人员表示迫切希望对患有肌无力症（MG）的患者进行二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的人体试验（《纽约时报》甚至对此进行了报道）。*

content.en: [A follow-up rat study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3876185/) then found DMSO suppressed anti-AChR antibody levels by an average of 53%–76%, with the effect being similar regardless of whether DMSO was given orally, rectally, or intraperitoneally. Additionally, DMSO treatment suppressed the anti-AChR antibody response to a weak primary antigenic stimulus. Interestingly, when given during strong primary or secondary immune responses, DMSO instead enhanced antibody production 1.7–2.8-fold — indicating bidirectional immune modulation depending on timing and stimulus strength (or DMSO’s ability to potentiate allergens).
content.cn: 随后的一项大鼠研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可将抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体水平平均抑制53%–76%，且无论采用口服、直肠给药还是腹腔注射给药，其抑制效果均相似。 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗还能抑制针对弱初级抗原刺激产生的抗AChR抗体反应。值得注意的是，当在强烈的初级或继发免疫应答期间给药时，DMSO反而会使抗体产生量增加1.7–2.8倍——这表明其免疫调节作用具有双向性，取决于给药时机和刺激强度（或DMSO增强过敏原活性的能力）。

content.en: These antibody findings were complemented by direct evidence that DMSO restores neuromuscular function. [In ex vivo](https://academic.oup.com/jpp/article-abstract/24/5/417/6200698?login=false) mouse nerve-muscle preparations where tubocurarine was used to mimic MG (reducing the strength of nerve-evoked muscle contractions), DMSO produced a rapid, dose-dependent, and sustained restoration of twitch force — with 0.1% restoring 20–30% of force and 0.75% achieving complete restoration that was sustained for over 150 minutes. Electrophysiology confirmed DMSO increased the amplitude of nerve signals at the muscle by ~25–30%, consistent with its acetylcholinesterase-inhibiting properties.
content.cn: 这些抗体研究结果得到了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可恢复神经肌肉功能的直接证据的印证。 在利用管状库拉林模拟肌无力（降低神经诱发的肌肉收缩强度）的小鼠体外神经-肌肉制备模型中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可快速、剂量依赖性且持续地恢复肌肉颤动力量——0.1%浓度可恢复20–30%的力量，0.75%浓度则可实现完全恢复，且该恢复状态可持续超过150分钟。 电生理学研究证实，二甲基亚砜使肌肉处的神经信号振幅增加了约25–30%，这与其乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制特性相一致。

content.en: Additional studies in frog and mammalian nerve-muscle preparations confirmed that DMSO at concentrations ≤1% enhanced neuromuscular transmission through acetylcholinesterase inhibition, while concentrations above 1% began to have depressant effects in mammals, and that THC (but not CBD) counteracted this restoration of neuromuscular function.<sup data-ref="384">384</sup>, <sup data-ref="385">385</sup>, <sup data-ref="386">386</sup>10419-7/abstract), <sup data-ref="387">387</sup> DMSO has also been shown to reverse neuromuscular blockade caused by organophosphates (which poison the same acetylcholinesterase system that is therapeutically targeted in MG).<sup data-ref="388">388</sup>, <sup data-ref="389">389</sup>, <sup data-ref="390">390</sup>, <sup data-ref="391">391</sup>, <sup data-ref="392">392</sup>, <sup data-ref="393">393</sup>针对青蛙和哺乳动物神经-肌肉制备物的进一步研究证实，浓度≤1%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶来增强神经肌肉传导，而浓度超过1%时则开始对哺乳动物产生抑制作用；此外，四氢大麻酚（THC）（而非大麻二酚CBD）可抵消这种神经肌肉功能的恢复。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 研究还表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够逆转有机磷化合物引起的神经肌肉阻断（有机磷化合物会毒害乙酰胆碱酯酶系统，而该系统正是重症肌无力（MG）治疗的靶点）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> ,

*Note: [this research inspired a 1982 study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0090122982901647) to determine if DMSO suppressed thyroid autoantibodies (which were experimentally induced in rats). It did, and also was found to increase the ratio of IgM to IgG plaque forming cells (which suggested a true immunoregulatory effect). In turn, some patients report that DMSO benefits autoimmune thyroiditis.
content.cn: 注：这项研究启发了一项1982年的研究，旨在确定二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是否能抑制甲状腺自身抗体（这些抗体是在大鼠身上通过实验诱导产生的）。研究结果表明，DMSO确实具有这种作用，并且还发现它能提高IgM与IgG斑块形成细胞的比例（这表明其具有真正的免疫调节作用）。因此，一些患者反映，DMSO对自身免疫性甲状腺炎有疗效。*

content.en: A variety of agents combined with DMSO have also shown benefit in experimental autoimmune MG models — including [resveratrol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201501&filename=1015505513.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=niESZZtdnfQJix7RCRNDPc3QeEtwOjsD-eZRBzqexhicS6EHxSxVQhYul41-1Ope) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced anti-AChR antibodies and protected AChR density at the neuromuscular junction), [total glucosides of peony](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202001&filename=1020017727.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=8aJLjug5upywrLTZWWsnQMmvgowRAmHDt12lV-uThFHN3I_aIjSGkrp2VdRewxqt) <sup>⬖</sup> and [artemisinin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2016&filename=ZSMB201603002&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=dGIB7C0IJdp7odWkekWnwlL1AWAN4cusL04_kaWWG_kAYrlzoU4oGsa_sSgkohU6) <sup>⬖</sup> (both reduced clinical scores and anti-AChR antibodies while modulating regulatory T cells), atorvastatin-derived exosomes,<sup data-ref="394">394</sup>, <sup data-ref="395">395</sup>, <sup data-ref="396">396</sup> and [a caspase-1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1016164619.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Ck0Kp9pDqxAT0I4lkKUTYtzquBWdxWgX5MzWQMjwK0_KKC8uKKkSEUYiwsiNH8Ns) (which suppressed disease progression via IL-1β/IL-17 pathways).
content.cn: 多种与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物在实验性自身免疫性肌无力（MG）模型中也显示出疗效——包括白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体水平并保护神经肌肉接头处的乙酰胆碱受体密度）、芍药总苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 和青蒿素 <sup>⬖</sup> （二者均能降低临床评分和抗AChR抗体水平，同时调节调节性T细胞），阿托伐他汀衍生的外泌体， <sup data-ref="394">394</sup> <sup data-ref="395">395</sup> <sup data-ref="396">396</sup> 以及一种半胱天冬酶-1抑制剂（该抑制剂通过IL-1β/IL-17通路抑制疾病进展）。

content.en: Separately, sepsis-induced disruption of acetylcholine receptor clustering on muscle cells was reversed by GSK3β inhibition, restoring the receptor aggregation needed for normal neuromuscular transmission.<sup data-ref="397">397</sup>, <sup data-ref="398">398</sup> In a rat sepsis model, [rapamycin](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2020&filename=1019659142.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=TM9sdtB4S_XSHfmiq6wArNzH2nckBzLH1NCOXgx7NcR4lSH3GPD1mCDwS0UZTe4f) similarly improved nerve conduction velocity, muscle action potential amplitude, and survival by restoring acetylcholine receptor homeostasis.
content.cn: 此外，脓毒症导致的肌肉细胞上乙酰胆碱受体聚集紊乱，可通过抑制GSK3β得到逆转，从而恢复正常神经肌肉传导所需的受体聚集。 <sup data-ref="397">397</sup> <sup data-ref="398">398</sup> 在大鼠脓毒症模型中，雷帕霉素同样通过恢复乙酰胆碱受体的稳态，改善了神经传导速度、肌肉动作电位振幅以及存活率。

content.en: Sadly, [while physicians have highlighted DMSO’s potential for human patients](https://asma.kglmeridian.com/downloadpdf/view/journals/asem/53/1/article-p82.pdf), no human studies have ever been performed for DMSO with MG. However, [one reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/80694307) with generalized MG reported that after starting oral and topical DMSO in 2022, her muscle fatigue, cognitive function, and vision dramatically improved, and she has not had a myasthenic crisis since. She noted that higher doses at night would wake her after an hour feeling alert and functional — which she attributed to DMSO boosting her acetylcholine levels — and described the effect as “better than the pyridostigmine I used to take 6x/day.” Another reader with generalized MG alongside multiple other autoimmune conditions reported no myasthenic crises since starting DMSO in 2022, along with dramatically reduced muscle fatigue, greatly improved cognition and near-normal vision — after having been on 30 prescription medications, she is now nearly off all of them <sup data-ref="399">399</sup>, <sup data-ref="400">400</sup> while a third reported “such amazing results” including “my swallowing and speaking goes back to normal” and “right side facial grimace reducing.” <sup data-ref="401">401</sup>, <sup data-ref="402">402</sup>
content.cn: 遗憾的是，尽管医生们已强调了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对人类患者的潜在疗效，但迄今为止尚未针对肌无力症（MG）患者开展过任何涉及DMSO的人体研究。不过，一位患有全身性肌无力症的读者报告称，自2022年开始口服和外用DMSO后，她的肌肉疲劳、认知功能和视力均显著改善，且此后再未出现过肌无力危机。 她指出，晚上服用较高剂量后，一小时左右就会醒来，感觉神清气爽且行动自如——她认为这是因为二甲基亚砜提高了她的乙酰胆碱水平——并形容这种效果“比我以前每天服用6次的吡啶斯汀还要好”。另一位患有全身性肌无力症并伴有多种其他自身免疫性疾病的读者报告称，自2022年开始使用二甲基亚砜以来，不仅再未出现肌无力危象，肌肉疲劳也大幅减轻， 认知能力显著提升，视力接近正常——此前她曾服用30种处方药，如今已几乎停用所有药物 <sup data-ref="401">401</sup> <sup data-ref="402">402</sup> ；还有一位读者报告了“如此惊人的效果”，包括“吞咽和说话功能恢复正常”以及“右侧面部抽搐减轻” <sup data-ref="401">401</sup> <sup data-ref="402">402</sup>

content.en: Diabetic Neuropathy
content.cn: 糖尿病神经病变

content.en: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy is one of the most common (and challenging) complications of diabetes, affecting up to 50% of patients and causing progressive sensory loss, pain, and weakness that frequently leads to foot ulcers and amputations. Fortunately, DMSO’s therapeutic mechanisms are well suited to addressing it (without affecting blood sugar like conventional corticosteroid treatment <sup data-ref="403">403</sup>) and many readers have shared profound improvements for diabetic neuropathy.
content.cn: 糖尿病周围神经病变是糖尿病最常见（且最具挑战性）的并发症之一，影响高达50%的患者，并导致感觉逐渐丧失、疼痛和肌无力，这些症状常会引发足部溃疡甚至截肢。幸运的是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗机制非常适合应对这一病症（且不会像传统皮质类固醇治疗那样影响血糖水平 <sup data-ref="403">403</sup> ），许多读者也分享了糖尿病神经病变症状显著改善的案例。

content.en: As such, DMSO has been considered as a treatment for diabetic hand syndrome (which can include scleredema, sclerodactyly, and Dupuytren contractures involving both neuropathic and vascular components).<sup data-ref="404">404</sup> For example, in a clinical study of 250 diabetic patients (88 with tunnel neuropathies, often comorbid with diabetic polyneuropathy), DMSO applications with novocaine were recommended to improve blood flow and reduce edema, though the primary therapeutic focus in that study was Tiogamma <sup>⬖</sup> (intravenous alpha-lipoic acid), which showed superior overall efficacy.<sup data-ref="405">405</sup>, <sup data-ref="406">406</sup>
content.cn: 因此，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）一直被视为治疗糖尿病手综合征（可能包括硬皮水肿、指端硬化及杜普伊特伦挛缩，这些病变均涉及神经病变和血管病变）的一种方法。 <sup data-ref="405">405</sup> 例如，在一项针对250名糖尿病患者（其中88名患有隧道性神经病变，常伴有糖尿病多发性神经病变）的临床研究中，建议使用DMSO与诺卡因联合外用以改善血流并减轻水肿，尽管该研究的主要治疗重点是Tiogamma <sup>⬖</sup> （静脉注射α-硫辛酸），其总体疗效更佳。 <sup data-ref="405">405</sup> <sup data-ref="406">406</sup>

content.en: A substantial body of preclinical research has used DMSO to deliver agents targeting the specific pathways disrupted in diabetic neuropathy. Multiple studies in diabetic Schwann cell and mouse models found that HDAC inhibitors ([trichostatin A](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxmqqXBkT-_MSyIhScN6MZFD32j2nAmNCq86OpWmUhvVkgmZfd2CGdy6gErqtR5PmFFtBAjff1ICpxsOySbXLk62JO_EEAGT6d09Pv5l_RjBa52p_mm0G6rba-Dr5rf-zucelS_gHDqMpwF9s3y2R5OutP3qu5ZZ3Y1Hj6lIYFnUsCdMv5feEh8S&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup>) upregulated DCXR expression, increased nerve growth factor, and improved peripheral nerve function including mechanical and thermal thresholds, with the therapeutic mechanism operating through HDAC5/DCXR signaling. [High glucose was shown to upregulate DNMT1 expression](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tfaAVNOhMrGWVIzErsGVATnvTv2xM6AmSLRswOfBfAX-6zVLUjDXhg4uPHdkRiZds4PKbZLdnWVr2_glICEdIVw4TH79nJNt1lepdd9nTXBznm_1Efln97PYkzqKo6MYT-48SM8FsluzCeks_01CLVUjK9bwJV-dB0St3iK9mA_zn6ra5cG9wGUhqa6GfoPFrI=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), increase BDNF promoter methylation, and reduce BDNF in Schwann cells (with the DNMT inhibitor 5-Aza-2’-deoxycytidine reversing this suppression), while diabetic mice showed reduced sciatic nerve BDNF and myelin abnormalities. [NF-κB inhibition](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdBmBpICOdD0TmTgRe_WN2AZvnSaghoK5MAJyP31AckH-TwSSuAeQQrIRUrtIafThcSPp6RXemrQqdgl0mGxnglO6iB7A5gpheVpuH7oaXKSb_wFsG1YVaWNYlDZ8ijAfMa3CWU7XF3WQIfjrYI7k2bFv6JaRgVo09PKtTnts_ar6MA-SaEh20PNfGPlpMchBs=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) restored autophagy in high-glucose Schwann cells by increasing Rab5 expression. [Trichostatin A](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tfmTgwhdvzZhoIMQyhrfSflh5W7OGWc1PRw6h5_2iav3K_uY0lvBUm2apIpT9_5wOiQ2_ddYod0Bu96Y4c7G9gyGNT6EGBrHFeecGGuE1Og1BiKZA69XxFWtbnZoE7M9EUH0j2Hn0-tLgD4hwF7_8m-xhmcxIEOIrzH9B_qQ1DizjvMy2HtfAET5EvZSaRRg6I=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> restored autophagy in high-glucose Schwann cells, increasing the LC3-II/LC3-I ratio by 1.6- to 1.74-fold.
content.cn: 大量临床前研究已利用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）递送针对糖尿病神经病变中受损特定通路的药物。多项针对糖尿病施万细胞和小鼠模型的研究发现，组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂（三唑甲酸A <sup>⬖</sup> ）可上调DCXR表达，增加神经生长因子水平，并改善包括机械阈值和热阈值在内的周围神经功能，其治疗机制是通过HDAC5/DCXR信号通路发挥作用的。 研究表明，高血糖会上调施万细胞中DNMT1的表达，增加BDNF启动子的甲基化，并降低BDNF水平（DNMT抑制剂5-Aza-2’-脱氧胞苷可逆转这种抑制作用），而糖尿病小鼠则表现出坐骨神经BDNF水平降低及髓鞘异常。 NF-κB抑制通过增加Rab5的表达，恢复了高血糖施万细胞中的自噬。三氯乙酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 恢复了高血糖施万细胞中的自噬，使LC3-II/LC3-I比值增加了1.6至1.74倍。

content.en: [Exogenous BDNF](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2019&filename=JNYY201904003&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=RV26SiqOHBLgZSxqqg9RCRKwSp1V3xHX0UB_wDiDnb5B8wdy04balvMiypWBOIZA) delivered intrathecally significantly elevated pain thresholds and inhibited hyperexcitability of dorsal root ganglion neurons in diabetic neuropathy rats (effects blocked by TrkB-Fc pretreatment). In chronic diabetic itch, [a P2Y12 antagonist](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3YueRuMhustdepsvGMMqi8RrzFbxgpniLHEvbO-u7p2DMyPLyUP5E9Kib-78RqGTs7mzg-3FsCIwJxvVY1uGodOJQFIBnApEfpFxaTpugFxdMQ-89DA7CJ0r16ygySi9Uqk7xocJPNHSroxJGWCvBp0nq11MQ-QJ8YNtcM-VF-oUTTleKQMnWQo7haVSyAviJs=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) alleviated thermal and cold hyperalgesia and improved sciatic nerve conduction velocity.
content.cn: 通过蛛网膜下腔给药的外源性脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）显著提高了糖尿病神经病变大鼠的痛阈，并抑制了背根神经节神经元的过度兴奋（该效应可被TrkB-Fc预处理所阻断）。在慢性糖尿病瘙痒模型中，P2Y12受体拮抗剂缓解了热痛和冷痛超敏反应，并改善了坐骨神经传导速度。

content.en: Additional agents showing neuroprotective effects in diabetic neuropathy models include [allopregnanolone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24176764/) (inhibited caspase-3, decreased the Bax/Bcl2 ratio, and prevented PC12 cell apoptosis from high glucose while ameliorating thermal hyperalgesia in diabetic rats), [resveratrol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33770763/) <sup>⬖</sup> (increased Nrf2 expression, inhibited NF-κB, reduced peripheral nerve apoptosis, and improved pain and temperature sensitivity), and [phloretin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29635891/) <sup>⬖</sup> (improved behavioral outcomes and sciatic nerve antioxidant status while reducing inflammation).
content.cn: 在糖尿病神经病变模型中表现出神经保护作用的其他药物还包括：异孕甾酮（抑制caspase-3，降低Bax/Bcl2比值，防止PC12细胞因高血糖而凋亡，同时缓解糖尿病大鼠的热痛觉过敏），白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可上调Nrf2表达、抑制NF-κB、减少周围神经凋亡，并改善疼痛和温度敏感性）以及弗洛雷汀 <sup>⬖</sup> （可改善行为结果和坐骨神经的抗氧化状态，同时减轻炎症）。

content.en: Finally, in diabetic cardiac autonomic neuropathy, [Ferrostatin-1 and P2X7 inhibitors](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcuihUEdD_oOr9_1oXK_ZtBjqKB4lV9PQhh5FHlMhjXA_sTPCZnm5JR2icgu_7Mph3qWMK0dr073mNIZVc00Xu6__lL3-Yl2ILIoQd-duJkeaPTkeBb2jQ7RUX39TkP7kyP6W3OdRUlvpFUvpkrmMpULFn0_QCkm2t4wwUgXSEFI2kAHQqEzrguBmJIM6M87VvU=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (e.g., hypericin <sup>⬖</sup>) reduced heart rate abnormalities, sympathetic discharge frequency, cardiac injury markers, and ferroptosis indicators.
content.cn: 最后，在糖尿病性心脏自主神经病变中，铁调节蛋白-1和P2X7受体抑制剂（例如，超靛素 <sup>⬖</sup> ）可减轻心率异常、交感神经放电频率、心脏损伤标志物以及铁死亡指标。

content.en: Chemo neuropathy
content.cn: 化疗性神经病变

content.en: In chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, [berberine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30536411/) <sup>⬖</sup> prevented paclitaxel-induced neuropathy in rats by improving pain thresholds, reducing sciatic nerve oxidative stress, and enhancing Nrf2 gene expression.
content.cn: 在化疗引起的周围神经病变中，小檗碱 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过提高疼痛阈值、减轻坐骨神经的氧化应激以及增强Nrf2基因的表达，成功预防了大鼠因紫杉醇引起的周围神经病变。

content.en: Likewise, DMSO, used as a transdermal delivery enhancer significantly enhanced the antihyperalgesic effect of [hyaluronan](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37467181/) <sup>⬖</sup>, reducing both prostaglandin E2 hyperalgesia and chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, with prolonged effects upon repeated application.
content.cn: 同样，作为经皮给药促进剂的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著增强了透明质酸的抗痛觉过敏作用 <sup>⬖</sup> ，既减轻了前列腺素E2引起的痛觉过敏，又缓解了化疗引起的周围神经病变，且反复使用后其作用可持续较长时间。

content.en: Vibrational Disease
content.cn: 振动性疾病

content.en: Vibration disease is an occupational condition caused by prolonged exposure to local vibration (typically from power tools), resulting in vascular, nerve, and musculoskeletal damage in the upper extremities.
content.cn: 振动病是一种由长期暴露于局部振动（通常来自电动工具）引起的职业病，会导致上肢的血管、神经和肌肉骨骼系统受损。

content.en: In patients with vibration disease, DMSO water solution applied as skin compresses to affected upper extremities for 1–1.5 hours daily over 12–15 procedures produced positive effects in most cases of regional angiodystonia (impaired circulation) and sensory or autonomic polyneuropathy, with partial benefit for muscle dystonia (spasms) and stiff or frozen shoulders. The technique simplified therapy by eliminating physiotherapy procedures and reducing or eliminating the need for medications, lowering both treatment costs and clinical course duration.<sup data-ref="407">407</sup>, <sup data-ref="408">408</sup> DMSO was also used as a topical agent for vibration disease in Chinese clinical practice, leveraging its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, vasodilatory, microcirculation-improving, and immunosuppressive properties.<sup data-ref="409">409</sup>
content.cn: 对于患有振动病的患者，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）水溶液作为皮肤敷料敷于受累的上肢，每天1–1.5小时，共进行12–15次治疗，对大多数局灶性血管紊乱（循环障碍）和感觉或自主神经多发性神经病变均产生了积极效果，并对肌肉痉挛（痉挛）以及肩周炎或冻结肩也具有部分疗效。 该疗法通过省去物理治疗步骤并减少或免除药物使用，简化了治疗流程，从而降低了治疗成本并缩短了临床病程。 <sup data-ref="409">409</sup> <sup data-ref="408">408</sup> 在中国的临床实践中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被用作振动病的局部用药，利用其镇痛、抗炎、血管扩张、改善微循环及免疫抑制等特性。 <sup data-ref="409">409</sup>

content.en: Peripheral Neuropathy Reader Reports
content.cn: 关于周围神经病变的读者报告

content.en: Many readers reported that peripheral neuropathy (from a wide range of causes) responded to DMSO, with relief typically beginning within one to several days after topical application to the affected area (most commonly the feet) and responses ranging from partial improvement to near-complete resolution.
content.cn: 许多读者反映，外周神经病变（病因多种多样）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有反应，通常在患处（最常见的是脚部）局部涂抹后一至数天内开始缓解，疗效从部分改善到几乎完全痊愈不等。

content.en: Diabetic Neuropathy
content.cn: 糖尿病神经病变

content.en: A type 1 diabetic with burning, itching leg pain (suspected neuropathy and nerve damage) found that a gel made their “legs feel a whole lot better.” <sup data-ref="410">410</sup> Another with type 2 diabetes who had gotten their A1C from 11.4 to 5.0 but still had lymphedema and neuropathy started DMSO: “I had lost about 80% of feeling from my knees down. I now have about 85% feeling in my legs and feet.” <sup data-ref="411">411</sup> Another reported DMSO “has resulted in FEELING RETURNING to the feet!!!!” <sup data-ref="412">412</sup> A reader used DMSO cream on their feet at night; tingling improved by day one, and by the fourth morning “all the purple mottling was completely gone.” <sup data-ref="413">413</sup> Additional readers with diabetic neuropathy reported pain reduction and restored sensation.<sup data-ref="414">414</sup>, <sup data-ref="415">415</sup>, <sup data-ref="416">416</sup>, <sup data-ref="370">370</sup>, <sup data-ref="417">417</sup>, <sup data-ref="418">418</sup>
content.cn: 一名患有1型糖尿病、腿部出现灼热、瘙痒和疼痛（疑似神经病变和神经损伤）的患者发现，使用一种凝胶后“腿部感觉好多了”。 <sup data-ref="414">414</sup> 另一名2型糖尿病患者，其糖化血红蛋白（A1C）已从11.4降至5.0，但仍患有淋巴水肿和神经病变，于是开始使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）： “我膝盖以下的感觉已经丧失了约80%。现在我的腿和脚的感觉恢复到了约85%。” <sup data-ref="414">414</sup> 还有一位读者报告称，二甲基亚砜“让脚底的感觉回来了！！！！” <sup data-ref="414">414</sup> 另一位读者晚上在脚上涂抹二甲基亚砜乳膏；第一天刺痛感就有所缓解，到了第四天早晨，“所有的紫色斑驳完全消失了。” <sup data-ref="414">414</sup> 其他患有糖尿病神经病变的读者也报告了疼痛减轻和感觉恢复的情况。 <sup data-ref="414">414</sup> <sup data-ref="415">415</sup> <sup data-ref="416">416</sup> <sup data-ref="370">370</sup> <sup data-ref="417">417</sup> <sup data-ref="418">418</sup>

content.en: After the first few \[topical\] applications, \[my husband\] began to get feeling back in his feet. This, after 9 years of basically numb feet.😳 [<sup>1</sup>](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/258042920)<sup>,</sup>[<sup>2</sup>](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/170496311)
content.cn: 在最初几次\[局部\]涂抹后，\[我丈夫\]的双脚开始恢复知觉了。此前，他的双脚已经麻木了整整9年。😳 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: Vaccine-Injury Neuropathy
content.cn: 疫苗致伤性神经病变

content.en: A reader developed acute inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (on the Guillain-Barré spectrum) eight days after the Shingrix vaccine, leaving them with painful foot spasms and numbness for five years. Topical DMSO eliminated the spasms from the first night of use.<sup data-ref="419">419</sup>, <sup data-ref="420">420</sup> Another developed peripheral neuropathy in the feet within weeks of the Pfizer booster and has been using 70% DMSO with castor oil twice daily for six months with “slow steady improvement.” <sup data-ref="421">421</sup> The reader who reported the Moderna vaccine injury (gastroparesis, brain fog, SFN, MCAS, POTS, tinnitus, insomnia) described all symptoms “improving for the first time in 3 1/2 years” with DMSO.<sup data-ref="422">422</sup>
content.cn: 一名读者在接种Shingrix疫苗八天后患上了急性炎症性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病（属于吉兰-巴雷综合征谱系），此后五年间一直饱受足部痉挛和麻木的折磨。外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）从使用第一晚起就消除了痉挛。 <sup data-ref="422">422</sup> <sup data-ref="420">420</sup> 另一位读者在接种辉瑞加强针数周内出现足部周围神经病变，过去六个月来每天两次使用70%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）混合蓖麻油进行治疗，症状呈现“缓慢而稳定的改善”。 <sup data-ref="422">422</sup> 报告莫德纳疫苗不良反应（胃轻瘫、脑雾、SFN、MCAS、POTS、耳鸣、失眠）的读者表示，在使用二甲基亚砜后，所有症状“3年半以来首次出现好转”。 <sup data-ref="422">422</sup>

content.en: Chemotherapy-Induced Neuropathy
content.cn: 化疗引起的神经病变

content.en: A reader with chemotherapy-induced neuropathy used DMSO on the feet and reported elimination of neuropathy within two weeks of daily application (compared to the back pain that resolved with a single application).<sup data-ref="423">423</sup>,<sup data-ref="424">424</sup> Another with neuropathy in hands, feet, and face from immunotherapy found significant improvements.<sup data-ref="425">425</sup> Finally, one reported shooting pains from peripheral neuropathy (from chemo 10 years prior) were controlled with nightly DMSO foot wraps or oral DMSO at bedtime.<sup data-ref="426">426</sup>, <sup data-ref="427">427</sup>, <sup data-ref="428">428</sup>, <sup data-ref="429">429</sup>
content.cn: 一位患有化疗诱发神经病变的读者在脚部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），并报告称每天使用两周后神经病变便消失了（相比之下，背痛仅需一次使用即可缓解）。 <sup data-ref="426">426</sup> ， <sup data-ref="427">427</sup> 另一位因免疫治疗导致手、脚和面部出现神经病变的患者也获得了显著改善。 <sup data-ref="426">426</sup> 最后，还有一位读者报告称，因10年前化疗引发的周围神经病变所导致的刺痛感，通过每晚用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）进行足部热敷或睡前口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）得到了控制。 <sup data-ref="426">426</sup> <sup data-ref="427">427</sup> <sup data-ref="428">428</sup> <sup data-ref="429">429</sup>

content.en: Other Neuropathies
content.cn: 其他神经病变

content.en: A reader shared 50% DMSO applied to the legs of a friend’s daughter born with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (a hereditary demyelinating neuropathy characterized by absent myelin sheath, painful leg bending, and buckling when standing) gave her immediate relief from the first application.<sup data-ref="515">515</sup>
content.cn: 一位读者分享道，将50%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）涂抹在一位患有夏科-马里-图斯病（一种遗传性脱髓鞘神经病变，主要表现为髓鞘缺失、腿部弯曲时疼痛以及站立时腿部无力）的朋友女儿的双腿上，从第一次使用起就立即缓解了她的症状。 <sup data-ref="515">515</sup>

content.en: The most visually striking report came from a reader whose 85-year-old mother’s toes and ankles had turned “a blackish blue color” from neuropathy, with nightly toe curling and cramping. After three weeks of daily DMSO, “the normal color has returned to her feet and legs. She has not had a cramp since the very first day of DMSO and she now has feeling back in both of her heels.” <sup data-ref="446">446</sup>
content.cn: 最引人注目的案例来自一位读者，他的85岁母亲因神经病变导致脚趾和脚踝呈现“黑蓝色”，且每晚都会出现脚趾蜷曲和抽筋的症状。 在连续三周每天使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，“她的脚和腿恢复了正常颜色。从开始使用DMSO的第一天起，她就再也没有出现过抽筋，现在双脚脚跟也恢复了知觉。” <sup data-ref="446">446</sup>

content.en: *Note: several readers noted that long-standing neuropathy improved more slowly than acute conditions, with some requiring weeks to months of consistent application,<sup data-ref="443">443</sup>, <sup data-ref="465">465</sup>, <sup data-ref="516">516</sup> while a few with very long-standing neuropathy reported only partial improvement.<sup data-ref="486">486</sup>, <sup data-ref="516">516</sup> One reader observed that while topical DMSO helped, switching to oral administration produced further benefit.<sup data-ref="517">517</sup>, <sup data-ref="454">454</sup>, <sup data-ref="456">456</sup>

content.en: Neuropathic Pain
content.cn: 神经病理性疼痛

content.en: Medical management of pain typically revolves around identifying the pain generator and providing a medical therapy (e.g., an anti-inflammatory or opioid) which is known to temporarily counteract the type of pain present. While this model is sometimes quite useful (e.g., it can be used to identify emergency conditions like appendicitis **which require immediate treatment**, prevent permanent sensitization from a severe acute injury, or offer relief when the underlying cause is untreatable), it frequently results in patients needing to take increasingly toxic doses of partially effective pain medications.
content.cn: 疼痛的药物治疗通常围绕确定疼痛源，并采用已知能暂时缓解当前疼痛类型的药物治疗（例如抗炎药或阿片类药物）。 虽然这种模式有时非常有用（例如，可用于识别需要立即治疗的急症如阑尾炎，防止严重急性损伤导致的永久性痛觉敏感化，或在根本原因无法治疗时提供缓解），但它往往导致患者需要服用毒性日益增强且仅部分有效的止痛药物。*

content.en: Note: this helps explain why, from the start, the most popular use for DMSO was pain management, as it was able to **safely** address a wide range of pain conditions conventional therapies often could not improve (e.g., DMSO use for cancer pain is discussed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms)), and likewise why, sixty years later, [the most popular article in this series](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) was on [DMSO’s uses for treating pain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) or why the most common testimonial I receive from readers was DMSO addressing some type of (often debilitating) source of pain nothing else had worked on. Sadly, despite immense needs for effective pain therapies (e.g., due to the opioid crisis), DMSO has languished in obscurity, something I believe boils down to pain management being one of the most reliable markets in medicine, and hence something many parties would not want to be displaced by an essentially free alternative.
content.cn: 注：这有助于解释为何从一开始，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最常见的用途就是疼痛管理——因为它能够安全地缓解多种传统疗法往往难以改善的疼痛症状（例如， 本文讨论了DMSO在癌症疼痛中的应用），同样也能解释为何六十年后，本系列中最受欢迎的文章是关于DMSO用于治疗疼痛的，以及为何我收到的读者反馈中，最常见的便是DMSO成功缓解了其他方法均无效的某种（往往令人衰弱）疼痛。 遗憾的是，尽管对有效镇痛疗法的需求巨大（例如，由于阿片类药物危机），二甲基亚砜却一直默默无闻。我认为这归根结底是因为疼痛管理是医学领域最可靠的市场之一，因此许多利益相关方不愿被一种本质上免费的替代方案所取代。*

content.en: From a young age, I was able to feel others’ pain, and in medicine, this caused me to gravitate towards a functional perspective on treating pain where, I would focus on why a pain generator caused pain, and then try to either directly address the pain generator or the process it triggered which caused pain. Because of this, while studying DMSO, it immediately jumped out to me that many of DMSO’s mechanisms overlapped with the mechanisms of the approaches I would use to treat pain, but rather than strongly affecting one process, it would instead have a diffuse effect on a variety of processes, thereby making it a safe (not too strong) “DIY” therapy individuals could often use at home without requiring the precise targeting many of the modalities I used required (while conversely, in a subset of pain cases, that targeting or a stronger therapy than DMSO was needed). For example DMSO:
content.cn: 从小我就能够感同身受他人的痛苦，这让我在医学领域倾向于采用功能性视角来治疗疼痛：我会着重探究疼痛源为何引发疼痛，然后尝试直接针对疼痛源，或针对其触发的导致疼痛的病理过程进行干预。 正因如此，在研究二甲基亚砜（DMSO）时，我立刻注意到其许多作用机制与我用于治疗疼痛的方法存在重叠。但与那些针对单一病理过程产生强烈作用的方法不同，DMSO会对多种病理过程产生广泛而温和的作用，因此成为一种安全的 （强度适中）的“DIY”疗法，人们通常可以在家中使用，而无需像我采用的许多疗法那样进行精准定位（当然，在部分疼痛病例中，则需要这种精准定位或比二甲基亚砜更强效的疗法）。例如二甲基亚砜：

content.en: •As described above, resets hypersensitive neural circuits.
content.cn: •如上所述，可重置过度敏感的神经回路。

content.en: • [Relaxes muscles](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses) (which, when tight, are often a root generator of pain)
content.cn: • 放松肌肉（肌肉紧张往往是疼痛的根本原因）

content.en: • [Increases arterial, venous, and lymphatic circulation](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) (also often a root generator of pain when dysfunctional)
content.cn: • 促进动脉、静脉和淋巴循环（当这些循环功能失调时，往往也是疼痛的根本诱因）

content.en: • [Is a powerful anti-inflammatory](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune), edema reducing and free radical scavenging agent (addressing another major subset of pain).
content.cn: • 是一种强效的抗炎、消肿和清除自由基的物质（可缓解另一类主要疼痛）。

content.en: • [Heals injured tissues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) (addressing another major subset of pain—nociceptive pain).
content.cn: • 修复受损组织（从而缓解另一种主要类型的疼痛——伤害性疼痛）。

content.en: One of the most challenging types of pain to treat, neuropathic pain arises from a lesion or disease of the somatosensory nervous system and is often characterized by burning, shooting, or electric-shock sensations with heightened sensitivity to touch and temperature. A closely related and equally difficult condition is nociplastic pain, which stems from altered nociceptive processing without clear tissue damage or nerve lesions, yet shares many of the same features and treatment resistance. In both cases, conventional analgesics often fail, and analgesic options such as anticonvulsants, antidepressants, and opioids typically provide only partial relief with significant side effects (e.g., the issues with the seizure drugs gabapentin and Lyrica are discussed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-they-dont-tell-us-about-treating)). DMSO, however, has consistently shown remarkable benefit for these pain states. This I attribute to it:
content.cn: 神经病理性疼痛是治疗难度最大的疼痛类型之一，源于躯体感觉神经系统的病变或疾病，通常表现为灼烧感、刺痛感或电击样感觉，并伴有触觉和温度敏感性增强。与之密切相关且同样难以治疗的病症是痛觉塑性性疼痛，其源于痛觉处理过程的改变，而无明显的组织损伤或神经病变，但两者具有许多共同特征，且均对治疗反应不佳。 在这两种情况下，传统镇痛药往往无效，而抗惊厥药、抗抑郁药和阿片类药物等镇痛选择通常只能提供部分缓解，且伴有显著的副作用（例如，本文讨论了抗癫痫药物加巴喷丁和利瑞卡的相关问题）。然而，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在治疗这些疼痛状态方面始终表现出显著的疗效。我认为这归因于以下原因：

content.en: - Resetting hypersensitive nerve circuits that trigger and maintain pain sensitization.
content.cn: 重置那些引发并维持疼痛敏感化的超敏神经回路。

content.en: - Restoring blood flow to nerves (improving endoneurial microcirculation, a key driver of neuropathic pain when impaired).<sup data-ref="4">4</sup>, <sup data-ref="3">3</sup>
content.cn: 恢复神经的血流（改善神经内膜微循环，该微循环一旦受损，便是神经病理性疼痛的主要诱因）。 <sup data-ref="4">4</sup> <sup data-ref="3">3</sup>

content.en: - Improving fluid balance inside nerves by reducing swelling and pressure while supporting axoplasmic flow.
content.cn: 通过减轻水肿和压力，同时促进轴浆流动，改善神经内部的体液平衡。

content.en: - Relieving compression on nerves (e.g., from tight muscles or edema).
content.cn: 缓解对神经的压迫（例如由肌肉紧张或水肿引起的）。

content.en: - Promoting actual healing and regeneration of damaged nerves <sup data-ref="4">4</sup>, <sup data-ref="5">5</sup> (thereby reducing ectopic firing and hypersensitivity that generate neuropathic pain).
content.cn: 促进受损神经的实际愈合与再生 <sup data-ref="4">4</sup> <sup data-ref="5">5</sup> （从而减轻导致神经病理性疼痛的异位放电和超敏反应）。

content.en: - Scavenging inflammatory free radicals that damage nerves and generate neuropathic pain.<sup data-ref="4">4</sup>, <sup data-ref="2">2</sup>
content.cn: 清除会损伤神经并引发神经病理性疼痛的炎症自由基。 <sup data-ref="4">4</sup> <sup data-ref="2">2</sup>

content.en: - Enhancing the body’s own pain-relieving systems (including stabilizing natural opioids like enkephalins and reducing pain transmitting substance P in the spinal cord).
content.cn: 增强人体自身的镇痛系统（包括稳定内源性阿片类物质（如脑啡肽）的水平，以及减少脊髓中传递疼痛的物质P的含量）。

content.en: - Balancing autonomic tone by reducing sympathetic overactivity and increasing parasympathetic activity via direct nerve-modulating effects and acetylcholinesterase inhibition (which is known to reduce postoperative pain, neuropathic pain, cancer pain, and chronic pain with opioid-sparing effects <sup data-ref="518">518</sup>, <sup data-ref="519">519</sup>, <sup data-ref="520">520</sup>, <sup data-ref="521">521</sup>).
content.cn: 通过直接的神经调节作用和乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制作用（已知可减轻术后疼痛、神经病理性疼痛、癌症疼痛和慢性疼痛，并具有减少阿片类药物用量的效果 <sup data-ref="518">518</sup> <sup data-ref="519">519</sup> <sup data-ref="520">520</sup> <sup data-ref="521">521</sup> ），减少交感神经过度活跃并增强副交感神经活动，从而平衡自主神经张力。

content.en: *Note: in Merck’s early trials, the one type of pain DMSO did not help was psychiatric pain, though given that psychiatric disorders can worsen existing pain (e.g., by increasing sympathetic tone, arteriolar constriction, or muscle contraction), DMSO could potentially reduce the psychiatric exacerbation of pain (although this area remains largely unstudied).<sup data-ref="522">522</sup>
content.cn: 注：在默克公司早期的临床试验中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）唯一无法缓解的疼痛类型是精神性疼痛；不过，鉴于精神障碍可能会加剧现有疼痛（例如通过增加交感神经张力、小动脉收缩或肌肉收缩），DMSO 或许能够减轻精神因素对疼痛的加剧作用（尽管这一领域目前仍缺乏充分研究）。 <sup data-ref="522">522</sup>*

content.en: - Selectively blocking the transmission of neuropathic pain signals.
content.cn: 有选择性地阻断神经病理性疼痛信号的传导。

content.en: - Allowing other therapeutic agents to be delivered directly to sites of neuropathic pain (e.g., 5% DMSO hydrogels [were shown](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28867811/) to facilitate permeation of gabapentin across human epidermal membranes, potentially enabling topical delivery for peripheral neuropathic pain and thereby bypassing the systemic complications of oral gabapentin and a Russian patent using a selective M1 inhibitor for topically treating neuropathic pain without weakening perception of normal stimuli.*<sup data-ref="523">523</sup>).*
content.cn: 允许其他治疗药物直接输送至神经病理性疼痛部位（例如，研究表明5%二甲基亚砜水凝胶可促进加巴喷丁穿过人体表皮膜，这可能为外周神经病理性疼痛提供局部给药途径，从而避免口服加巴喷丁带来的全身性并发症；此外，一项俄罗斯专利利用选择性M1受体抑制剂进行神经病理性疼痛的局部治疗，且不会削弱对正常刺激的感知。 <sup data-ref="523">523</sup> ）。

content.en: *Note: [Safranal](https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/7ad0/e5b9a111b920d05ab0d9c63f4c3f42b08abc.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO produced significant analgesia mediated entirely through the GABAergic pathway (unaffected by naloxone), confirming the existence of opioid-independent analgesic mechanisms accessible through DMSO-delivered natural compounds.<sup data-ref="524">524</sup>
content.cn: 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的萨弗纳尔（Safranal） <sup>⬖</sup> 产生了显著的镇痛作用，该作用完全通过γ-氨基丁酸能（GABAergic）通路介导（不受纳洛酮影响），这证实了通过二甲基亚砜递送的天然化合物可发挥与阿片类药物无关的镇痛机制。 <sup data-ref="524">524</sup>*

content.en: As many of these (e.g., circulatory improvements and healing of nerves) were discussed in the [first](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) and [second](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses) parts of this series (or previously in this article), I will now focus on a few of DMSO’s pain reducing mechanisms that were not previously discussed and specifically relate to neuropathic pain and nociplastic pain.
content.cn: 由于其中许多内容（例如改善血液循环和神经修复）已在本系列的第一、二部分（或本文前文）中讨论过，因此我将重点介绍DMSO的几种此前未曾提及的镇痛机制，这些机制特别与神经病理性疼痛和痛觉塑性性疼痛有关。

content.en: *Note: I believe a significant portion of nociplastic pain results from brain tissue injury (e.g., a loss of blood flow to pain-dampening regions or direct compression of brain tissue). Many of the mechanisms listed above [also operate in the brain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) (e.g., [Russian researchers extensively demonstrated](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) DMSO's ability to reduce the brain tissue injury and functional loss resulting from chronic stress).
content.cn: 注：我认为，相当一部分神经塑性性疼痛源于脑组织损伤（例如，镇痛区域的血流减少或脑组织的直接受压）。上述列举的许多机制在脑内同样起作用（例如，俄罗斯研究人员已通过大量研究证实，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够减轻慢性应激导致的脑组织损伤和功能丧失）。*

content.en: Preventing Pain Transmission
content.cn: 阻断疼痛传导

content.en: Many different nerve fibers exist in the body. One group, known as the “small fibers,” is responsible for transmitting specific sensations. In particular, C fibers are frequently linked to debilitating chronic pain syndromes. For example, in small fiber neuropathy they commonly produce sensations of pins-and-needles, pricks, tingling, and numbness alongside burning pain and electrical shocks, while in nociplastic pain C fibers transmit slow, diffuse, dull, aching, or burning sensations.
content.cn: 人体内存在许多不同类型的神经纤维。 其中一类被称为“小纤维”，负责传递特定的感觉。特别是C纤维，常与令人衰弱的慢性疼痛综合征相关。例如，在小纤维神经病变中，C纤维通常会产生针刺感、刺痛、麻木等感觉，同时伴有灼痛和电击样疼痛；而在痛觉塑性性疼痛中，C纤维则传递缓慢、弥漫、钝痛、酸痛或灼痛等感觉。

content.en: *Note: the five most common symptoms of COVID vaccine injuries, in order, are fatigue, post-exertional malaise, brain fog (discussed further [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/we-now-have-proof-the-covid-vaccines) and [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/yales-censored-vaccine-injury-research)), small fiber neuropathy, and dysautonomia.
content.cn: 注：新冠疫苗不良反应最常见的五种症状依次为：疲劳、运动后不适、脑雾（详见此处和此处）、小纤维神经病变以及自主神经功能障碍。*

content.en: Due to DMSO affecting nerves in a biophysical manner, at therapeutic concentrations it selectively blocks the conduction of small nerve fibers <sup data-ref="525">525</sup> (the C fibers) while not affecting larger nerve fibers <sup data-ref="525">525</sup> thereby allowing it to address neuropathic pain without altering the other functions of the nervous system (which may explain why rather than developing a resistance to it, chronic pain patients often find DMSO’s efficacy increases over time). Specifically:
content.cn: 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以生物物理学的方式作用于神经，因此在治疗浓度下，它会选择性地阻断小神经纤维 <sup data-ref="525">525</sup> （即C纤维）的传导，却不会影响较粗的神经纤维 <sup data-ref="525">525</sup> ，从而使其能够在不改变神经系统其他功能的情况下缓解神经病理性疼痛（这或许可以解释，为什么慢性疼痛患者往往不会对DMSO产生耐受性，反而会发现其疗效随时间推移而增强）。具体而言：

content.en: •In cat sural nerves, 5% DMSO slowed C fiber conduction velocity and decreased amplitude, 9% blocked conduction entirely, and the block was instantaneous at 15%, with all effects reversing once DMSO was washed off.<sup data-ref="525">525</sup>, <sup data-ref="526">526</sup>
content.cn: •在猫的胫神经中，5%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会减慢C纤维的传导速度并降低其振幅；9%的DMSO会完全阻断传导；而当浓度达到15%时，阻断作用是瞬时的；一旦洗去DMSO，所有这些效应都会逆转。 <sup data-ref="525">525</sup> <sup data-ref="526">526</sup>

content.en: •In cat radial nerves, lower concentrations selectively blocked C fibers and then Aδ fibers (the two fiber types responsible for pain transmission), while higher concentrations were required to affect the larger Aβ and Aγ fibers, with 5-10% DMSO also blocking C-fiber afterdischarges (a process associated with painful stimuli).<sup data-ref="527">527</sup> At much higher concentrations (75–100%), this preferential pattern persisted and was reversible if washed off early.<sup data-ref="528">528</sup>
content.cn: •在猫的桡神经中，较低浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会选择性地阻断C纤维，随后阻断Aδ纤维（这两种纤维类型负责疼痛传导），而要影响较粗的Aβ和Aγ纤维则需要更高浓度；此外，5%–10%的DMSO还会阻断C纤维的后放电（这一过程与疼痛刺激相关）。 <sup data-ref="528">528</sup> 在更高浓度（75–100%）下，这种选择性阻断模式依然存在，且若能及早冲洗掉，该效应可逆。 <sup data-ref="528">528</sup>

content.en: •In isolated frog sciatic nerves, 6% DMSO significantly slowed conduction velocity (which reversed once the nerves were washed).*<sup data-ref="529">529</sup>*
content.cn: •在离体的青蛙坐骨神经中，6%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著降低了传导速度（但经冲洗后该现象即恢复正常）。 <sup data-ref="529">529</sup>

content.en: *Note: this author concluded the conduction blocking was likely due to mechanisms such as cholinesterase inhibition rather than direct nerve blockade.
content.cn: 注：该作者认为，传导阻滞很可能是由胆碱酯酶抑制等机制引起的，而非直接的神经阻滞。*

content.en: •One detailed review found DMSO’s analgesic effects lasted approximately 6 hours (compared with 2 hours for morphine), and intrathecal (into the CSF) 50% DMSO produced 30 minutes of complete anesthesia in cats with full recovery. The same review confirmed that 5-10% DMSO rapidly blocked pain-conducting C fibers and that 6% DMSO reduced sciatic nerve conduction velocity by 40%.<sup data-ref="530">530</sup>
content.cn: •一项详细综述发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的镇痛作用可持续约6小时（而吗啡仅为2小时），且向猫的脑脊液中注射50%二甲基亚砜溶液可产生30分钟的完全麻醉，且猫能完全恢复。 该综述还证实，5%-10%的DMSO可迅速阻断传导疼痛的C纤维，而6%的DMSO可使坐骨神经传导速度降低40%。 <sup data-ref="530">530</sup>

content.en: These nerve-blocking properties suggest DMSO could be combined with natural substances that independently block nerve conduction. [In isolated frog sciatic nerves](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/pain/29/1/29_3/_pdf/-char/ja), various aroma oil compounds dissolved in DMSO concentration-dependently and reversibly inhibited compound action potentials through mechanisms independent of TRP channel activation, with linalyl acetate <sup>⬖</sup> showing efficacy comparable to lidocaine, ropivacaine, and cocaine, and linalool,<sup>⬖</sup> citral,<sup>⬖</sup> and citronellal <sup>⬖</sup> also demonstrating significant blocking activity.<sup data-ref="531">531</sup> Capsaicin and related vanilloid compounds <sup>⬖</sup> (including eugenol <sup>⬖</sup> and dihydrocapsaicin <sup>⬖</sup>) similarly blocked nerve conduction independent of TRPV1 activation, through direct sodium channel blockade with potency determined by the hydrophobic side chain length.<sup data-ref="532">532</sup> Likewise, Kampo herbal formulations (particularly daikenchuto,<sup>⬖</sup> containing processed ginger, ginseng, and Japanese pepper) concentration-dependently inhibited nerve conduction (~70% reduction at 2 mg/ml) partly through plant-derived TRP agonists (piperine,<sup>⬖</sup> cinnamaldehyde <sup>⬖</sup>) but also through TRP-independent mechanisms, with 1% DMSO alone having no effect on compound action potentials.<sup data-ref="533">533</sup>, <sup data-ref="534">534</sup>
content.cn: 这些神经阻断特性表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可与能够独立阻断神经传导的天然物质结合使用。在离体的青蛙坐骨神经中，溶解于DMSO中的各种香薰油化合物通过独立于TRP通道激活的机制，以浓度依赖性和可逆的方式抑制了复合动作电位，其中乙酸芳樟酯 <sup>⬖</sup> 的功效可与利多卡因、罗哌卡因和可卡因相媲美，而芳樟醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 柠檬醛、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及香茅醛 <sup>⬖</sup> 也表现出显著的阻断活性。 <sup data-ref="533">533</sup> 辣椒素及相关香草酮类化合物 <sup>⬖</sup> （包括丁香酚 <sup>⬖</sup> 和二氢辣椒素 <sup>⬖</sup> ）同样通过直接阻断钠通道来阻断神经传导，其效力取决于疏水侧链的长度，且该作用与TRPV1激活无关。 <sup data-ref="533">533</sup> 同样，汉方制剂（特别是含有加工生姜、人参和山椒的大建中汤 <sup>⬖</sup> ）以浓度依赖性方式抑制了神经传导（2 mg/ml 时减少约 70%），部分是通过植物来源的 TRP 激动剂 （胡椒碱、 <sup>⬖</sup> 肉桂醛 <sup>⬖</sup> ），但也通过TRP独立机制发挥作用，而单独使用1%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对复合动作电位则无影响。 <sup data-ref="533">533</sup> <sup data-ref="534">534</sup>

content.en: *Note: an insect study found DMSO preferentially inhibits peripheral sensory receptor activity over axonal conduction: in a proprioceptive organ, DMSO blocked sensory neuron responses to mechanical stimulation at just 0.85% (50% block in 18-20 minutes), while blocking sensory axon conduction required roughly five times higher concentration (4.6%), demonstrating sensory receptor inactivation as a distinct analgesic mechanism separate from C fiber conduction block.<sup data-ref="535">535</sup>
content.cn: 注：一项昆虫研究发现，DMSO 优先抑制外周感觉受体的活动，而非轴突传导： 在一种本体感觉器官中，DMSO仅需0.85%的浓度即可阻断感觉神经元对机械刺激的反应（18-20分钟内阻断率达50%），而阻断感觉轴突传导则需要大约五倍的浓度（4.6%），这表明感觉受体的失活是一种与C纤维传导阻断不同的独特镇痛机制。 <sup data-ref="535">535</sup>*

content.en: Receptor and Ion Channel Modulation
content.cn: 受体和离子通道的调节

content.en: DMSO suppresses NMDA and AMPA induced ion fluxes in neurons, each of which are receptors linked to chronic pain (e.g., NMDA is linked to central pain sensitization),<sup data-ref="536">536</sup>, <sup data-ref="537">537</sup> a property I believe may partly account for why DMSO treats complex regional pain syndrome and which has also been proposed to explain [its utility in treating cancer pain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms).<sup data-ref="538">538</sup>, <sup data-ref="6">6</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可抑制神经元中由NMDA和AMPA受体诱导的离子流，这两种受体均与慢性疼痛相关（例如，NMDA受体与中枢性疼痛敏感化相关）， <sup data-ref="538">538</sup> <sup data-ref="6">6</sup> 我认为这一特性或许能部分解释为何DMSO能治疗复杂性区域疼痛综合征，且该特性也被认为可解释其在治疗癌症疼痛方面的功效。 <sup data-ref="538">538</sup> <sup data-ref="6">6</sup>

content.en: Like local anesthetics, DMSO has also been observed to block sodium and calcium ions’ entry into cells, which has been proposed to explain how DMSO can help cancer pain.<sup data-ref="539">539</sup>, <sup data-ref="538">538</sup> Likewise, in whole-cell voltage-clamp studies on differentiated neuroblastoma × glioma hybrid cells, DMSO (0.5–1%) reversibly blocked voltage-gated Na⁺, K⁺, and Ca²⁺ currents, with effects resembling those of local and general anesthetics.<sup data-ref="540">540</sup>
content.cn: 与局部麻醉药类似，研究还发现二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能阻断钠离子和钙离子进入细胞，据推测这可以解释DMSO为何能缓解癌症疼痛。 <sup data-ref="540">540</sup> <sup data-ref="538">538</sup> 同样，在针对分化后的神经母细胞瘤×胶质瘤杂交细胞进行的全细胞电压钳研究中，二甲基亚砜（0.5–1%）可逆地阻断了电压门控的Na⁺、K⁺和Ca²⁺电流，其作用与局部麻醉剂和全身麻醉剂的作用相似。 <sup data-ref="540">540</sup>

content.en: Finally, detailed electrophysiological studies in unmyelinated neurons confirm that DMSO blocks nerve impulses at approximately 8–15% concentrations and that small-diameter C fibers are preferentially affected at lower doses than larger myelinated fibers.¹ This blockade was found to arise partly from depolarization of the resting membrane potential caused by reduced permeability to potassium and chloride ions, together with suppression of the delayed potassium current that prolongs spike repolarization.<sup data-ref="541">541</sup>
content.cn: 最后，针对无髓鞘神经元的详细电生理研究证实，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在浓度约为8%–15%时会阻断神经冲动，且在小剂量下，小直径C纤维受影响的程度比大直径有髓鞘纤维更为显著。¹ 研究发现，这种阻断部分源于钾离子和氯离子通透性降低导致的静息膜电位去极化，同时伴随延迟钾电流的抑制，从而延长了动作电位的复极化时间。 <sup data-ref="541">541</sup>

content.en: Central analgesic effects
content.cn: 中枢镇痛作用

content.en: Beyond interrupting peripheral nerve pain transmission, DMSO exerts direct pain-suppressing effects within the spinal cord and brain:
content.cn: 除了阻断周围神经的疼痛传导外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还在脊髓和大脑内发挥直接的镇痛作用：

content.en: •Intraperitoneal DMSO (50%) reduced the nociceptive response to capsaicin injection by 73.1% and independently raised pain thresholds in the tail-flick test, with DMSO’s analgesic effect attributed to central (likely NMDA receptor-mediated) mechanisms rather than peripheral afferent modulation.<sup data-ref="542">542</sup>, <sup data-ref="543">543</sup>, <sup data-ref="544">544</sup>
content.cn: •腹腔注射二甲基亚砜（50%）可将辣椒素注射引起的痛觉反应降低73.1%，并在尾部闪避试验中独立提高疼痛阈值；二甲基亚砜的镇痛作用归因于中枢（可能由NMDA受体介导）机制，而非外周传入神经的调节。 <sup data-ref="542">542</sup> <sup data-ref="543">543</sup> <sup data-ref="544">544</sup>

content.en: •DMSO microinjected into the rostral ventromedial medulla (a part of the brain) potentiated swim stress-induced analgesia across all phases of the formalin test, likely by increasing neuronal excitability in descending inhibitory pain pathways.<sup data-ref="545">545</sup>
content.cn: •将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）微量注射入脑干前腹内侧部（大脑的一部分）后，在福尔马林试验的所有阶段均增强了游泳应激诱导的镇痛效应，这很可能是通过增加下行抑制性疼痛通路中神经元的兴奋性来实现的。 <sup data-ref="545">545</sup>

content.en: •In rats, intrathecal DMSO reduced pain transmitting substance P and calcitonin gene-related peptide levels in the spinal cord and increased hot plate latency, indicating direct central antinociception.<sup data-ref="546">546</sup> In another study (modeling bone cancer pain) it increased mechanical and thermal pain thresholds and decreased spinal microglial markers (OX-42 and Iba-1), confirming DMSO’s central anti-neuroinflammatory and analgesic properties even in severe pain states**.<sup data-ref="547">547</sup>** Finally, DMSO injected directly into the cerebrospinal fluid has been shown to induce total anesthesia in animals without causing any adverse reactions.<sup data-ref="548">548</sup> Additionally, direct application of DMSO into surgical wounds relieved acute pain in rats, providing further evidence of DMSO's independent analgesic properties at the site of tissue injury.<sup data-ref="549">549</sup>
content.cn: •在大鼠实验中，鞘内注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）降低了脊髓中疼痛传递物质P和降钙素基因相关肽的水平，并延长了热板试验的潜伏期，表明其具有直接的中枢抗痛觉作用。 <sup data-ref="549">549</sup> 在另一项研究（骨癌疼痛模型）中，它提高了机械痛和热痛阈值，并降低了脊髓小胶质细胞标志物（OX-42 和 Iba-1）的水平，证实了即使在严重疼痛状态下，DMSO 仍具有中枢抗神经炎症和镇痛特性。 <sup data-ref="549">549</sup> 最后，研究表明，将二甲基亚砜直接注入脑脊液可诱导动物进入完全麻醉状态，且不会引起任何不良反应。 <sup data-ref="549">549</sup> 此外，将二甲基亚砜直接涂抹于手术伤口可缓解大鼠的急性疼痛，这进一步证明了二甲基亚砜在组织损伤部位具有独立的镇痛特性。 <sup data-ref="549">549</sup>

content.en: •Topical DMSO can also activate spinal inhibitory circuits. Cutaneous application activated Aδ-afferents, which then suppressed C-afferent pain transmission through an intersegmental mechanism mediated by presynaptic GABA(B) receptors on C-afferent central terminals.<sup data-ref="550">550</sup>
content.cn: •外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能激活脊髓抑制回路。经皮肤给药可激活Aδ传入纤维，进而通过C传入纤维中枢末梢上的突触前GABA(B)受体介导的节间机制，抑制C传入纤维的疼痛传导。 <sup data-ref="550">550</sup>

content.en: •Additionally, in the spinal nerve ligation (SNL) model of peripheral nerve injury, intrathecal DMSO prevented GABAergic neuron dysfunction and loss in the dorsal horn, central sensitization of dorsal horn neurons, and mechanical hypersensitivity through its free radical scavenging properties.<sup data-ref="551">551</sup>00286-2/fulltext) This suggests that DMSO may help mitigate central sensitization following certain peripheral nerve injuries.
content.cn: •此外，在脊神经结扎（SNL）这一周围神经损伤模型中，鞘内注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过其清除自由基的特性，防止了背角中γ-氨基丁酸能神经元的功能障碍和丧失、背角神经元的中枢敏感化以及机械性痛觉过敏。 <sup data-ref="551">551</sup> 这表明，DMSO 可能有助于缓解某些周围神经损伤后出现的中枢敏感化。

content.en: Dose-dependence
content.cn: 剂量依赖性

content.en: Since DMSO also enhances the function of nerves, in some studies, at low concentrations, it increased rather than reduced pain transmission:
content.cn: 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能增强神经功能，因此在某些研究中，低浓度的DMSO反而会增强而非减弱疼痛传导：

content.en: •At very low concentrations (0.3-1%), DMSO enhanced rather than blocked nociceptive transmission in isolated neonatal rat spinal cord, potentiating substance P- and capsaicin-induced depolarization through cholinesterase inhibition (while having no effect on myelinated A-fiber reflexes).<sup data-ref="552">552</sup>
content.cn: •在极低浓度（0.3-1%）下，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在离体新生大鼠脊髓中增强了痛觉传导，而非阻断它，通过抑制胆碱酯酶，增强了P物质和辣椒素诱导的去极化（但对有髓A纤维反射无影响）。 <sup data-ref="552">552</sup>

content.en: •In mice, DMSO injected directly into the brain produced strong antinociception (pain reduction), oral administration produced slight antinociception with anti-inflammatory effects, but subcutaneous local administration (which delivers the smallest amount of DMSO to the central nervous system) it increased nociceptive (pain sensing) responses.<sup data-ref="553">553</sup>
content.cn: •在小鼠实验中，直接注入脑内的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生了强烈的抗痛觉作用（减轻疼痛）；口服给药则产生了轻微的抗痛觉作用并具有抗炎效应；但皮下局部给药（这种给药方式向中枢神经系统输送的DMSO量最少）却增强了痛觉（疼痛感知）反应。 <sup data-ref="553">553</sup>

content.en: •Cutaneous DMSO enhanced the nociceptive response to capsaicin (a TRPV1 agonist) in a time- and dose-dependent manner: at 30 minutes pre-application, 10-100% DMSO dose-dependently increased the pain reaction, while at 1 minute pre-application (when DMSO had not yet had time to diffuse away to a lower concentration) no effect was seen at any concentration.<sup data-ref="554">554</sup>
content.cn: •经皮肤给药的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以时间和剂量依赖性方式增强了对辣椒素（一种TRPV1激动剂）的痛觉反应：在应用前30分钟给药时，10%–100%浓度的DMSO会以剂量依赖性方式增强痛觉反应；而在应用前1分钟给药时（此时DMSO尚未有时间扩散至较低浓度），无论何种浓度均未观察到影响。 <sup data-ref="554">554</sup>

content.en: Conversely, low doses of DMSO also have been shown to reduce pain. For example, 0.3% DMSO prevented acetic acid-induced pain behaviors in zebrafish larvae, performing comparably to Tylenol and outperforming ibuprofen (which showed no analgesic effect), likely operating via a Pannexin-1-related pathway.<sup data-ref="555">555</sup>, <sup data-ref="556">556</sup> *Note: [low concentrations of DMSO](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Amany-Hasanin/publication/259801977) masked the antinociceptive activity of Tylenol in the mouse formalin test—however I am not aware of any similar reports in humans.*
content.cn: 相反，研究还表明低剂量的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能缓解疼痛。例如，0.3%的DMSO可抑制斑马鱼幼鱼的醋酸诱导性疼痛行为，其效果与泰诺相当，且优于布洛芬（后者未显示出镇痛作用），其作用机制很可能与Pannexin-1相关通路有关。 <sup data-ref="555">555</sup> <sup data-ref="556">556</sup> 注：在小鼠福尔马林试验中，低浓度的二甲基亚砜掩盖了泰诺的抗痛觉作用——但我尚未发现有关人类的类似报道。

content.en: Lastly, I have not received reports from readers of low doses of topical DMSO worsening pain. However, I am including this section for individuals with challenging pain cases seeking additional insights for developing an effective treatment protocol.
content.cn: 最后，我尚未收到读者反馈称低剂量的外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会加剧疼痛。不过，我还是增设了这一部分内容，供那些面临棘手疼痛病例、并希望获得更多见解以制定有效治疗方案的医生参考。

content.en: Opioid-independent analgesia and endogenous pain modulation
content.cn: 非阿片类镇痛与内源性疼痛调节

content.en: Opioids work by stimulating pain-blocking receptors that evolved to respond to opioid-like molecules the body naturally produces (endorphins). In 1985, a clinician discovered that giving low doses of an opioid receptor blocker (naltrexone) triggered the body to increase its own endorphin and enkephalin production, and that beyond modulating pain, low-dose naltrexone (LDN) broadly improved immune function, reducing inflammation while increasing resistance to both infections and cancer. As such, LDN (discussed further [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-do-we-determine-the-correct-dose)) has become an immensely popular integrative therapy (e.g., for fibromyalgia and a variety of autoimmune or chronic inflammatory disorders). Conversely, in opioid users, beyond addiction resulting from the down regulation of the body’s opioid system, a variety of other health issues also emerge such as increased pain sensitivity (opioid-induced hyperalgesia), persistent low mood and anhedonia (loss of ability to enjoy life), hormonal disruptions (such as low testosterone), weakened immune function, reduced bone density, and poorer stress resilience.
content.cn: 阿片类药物的作用机制是刺激那些能够阻断疼痛的受体，这些受体在进化过程中形成，用于响应人体自然产生的类似阿片类分子的物质（内啡肽）。 1985年，一位临床医生发现，给予低剂量的阿片受体拮抗剂（纳曲酮）会促使人体增加自身内啡肽和脑啡肽的分泌；而且，除了调节疼痛外，低剂量纳曲酮（LDN）还能广泛改善免疫功能，在减轻炎症的同时增强对感染和癌症的抵抗力。 因此，LDN（本文将进一步探讨）已成为一种广受欢迎的整合疗法（例如，用于治疗纤维肌痛以及各种自身免疫性或慢性炎症性疾病）。 相反，在阿片类药物使用者中，除了因机体阿片系统下调而导致的成瘾外，还会出现多种其他健康问题，例如疼痛敏感性增加（阿片类药物诱导的痛觉过敏）、持续情绪低落和快感缺失（丧失享受生活的能力）、激素紊乱（如睾酮水平低下）、免疫功能减弱、骨密度降低以及应激韧性下降。

content.en: DMSO addresses both sides of this equation. As early as 1974, [a Nature article](https://www.nature.com/articles/247421a0) noted DMSO held “significant promise for neurological injuries and incapacitating pain” but that it had been “held to an unduly rigorous standard for testing,” leaving it unclear whether its potential would ever be properly studied in humans. Fifty years later, that question remains unanswered, but the evidence for DMSO’s opioid-independent analgesia has only grown stronger.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）同时解决了这一方程式的两个方面。早在1974年，《自然》杂志上的一篇文章就指出，DMSO在“神经损伤和致残性疼痛的治疗方面具有显著潜力”，但其“被要求达到过分严格的测试标准”，因此尚不清楚其潜力是否能最终在人体上得到妥善研究。 五十年后的今天，这个问题依然悬而未决，但关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有阿片类药物独立镇痛作用的证据却日益确凿。

content.en: In direct comparison, DMSO produced analgesic effects comparable in magnitude to morphine, but with a duration of 6–7 hours or sometimes much longer (versus 2 hours for morphine), and this effect was rarely reversed by naloxone, indicating the mechanism is likely independent of opioid receptors.<sup data-ref="557">557</sup>, <sup data-ref="558">558</sup>, <sup data-ref="559">559</sup>, <sup data-ref="560">560</sup> Likewise, in horses, IV DMSO produced analgesia clinically similar to phenylbutazone (a potent NSAID), acting via blockade of glutamatergic pathways and NMDA receptors in the CNS rather than through opioid mechanisms, with a half-life of approximately 8.53 hours allowing safe twice-daily administration.<sup data-ref="561">561</sup>
content.cn: 直接比较发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生的镇痛效果在强度上可与吗啡媲美，但持续时间为6–7小时，有时甚至更长（而吗啡仅持续2小时），且这种效果极少被纳洛酮逆转，这表明其作用机制很可能与阿片受体无关。 <sup data-ref="561">561</sup> <sup data-ref="558">558</sup> <sup data-ref="559">559</sup> <sup data-ref="560">560</sup> 同样， 在马身上，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生的镇痛效果在临床上与苯丁唑（一种强效非甾体抗炎药）相似，其作用机制是通过阻断中枢神经系统中的谷氨酸能通路和NMDA受体，而非通过阿片类机制，其半衰期约为8.53小时，因此可安全地每日给药两次。 <sup data-ref="561">561</sup>

content.en: Beyond providing opioid-independent pain relief, DMSO appears to amplify the body’s own opioid signaling through multiple mechanisms. NMR studies show that enkephalins (the body’s natural opioids) adopt a compact bioactive conformation in DMSO that pre-organizes their key residues into a morphine-like shape capable of activating opioid receptors (potentially enhancing the efficacy of even trace amounts of endogenous enkephalins).<sup data-ref="562">562</sup>, <sup data-ref="563">563</sup> Additionally, in cell culture, 2% DMSO increased functional μ-opioid receptor expression up to 6-fold (while also upregulating κ-opioid receptors) without altering receptor affinity.<sup data-ref="564">564</sup> Complementing this, DMSO enables topical opioid delivery. When morphine or enkephalin analogs were dissolved in DMSO and applied topically to mouse tails, they produced potent, dose-dependent analgesia with no detectable systemic absorption, and repeated exposure induced only local (not systemic) tolerance that was blocked by NMDA antagonism.<sup data-ref="565">565</sup> This suggests DMSO could enable targeted localized opioid pain relief without the systemic side effects, tolerance, and addiction that make chronic opioid use so problematic.
content.cn: 除了提供不依赖阿片类药物的镇痛作用外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）似乎还能通过多种机制增强人体自身的阿片类信号传导。核磁共振（NMR）研究表明，内啡肽（人体内源性阿片类物质）在DMSO中会呈现紧凑的生物活性构象，这种构象将关键残基预先组织成类似吗啡的形状，从而能够激活阿片受体（甚至可能增强微量内源性内啡肽的功效）。 <sup data-ref="565">565</sup> <sup data-ref="563">563</sup> 此外，在细胞培养实验中，2% 的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可将功能性 μ-阿片受体的表达水平提高至 6 倍（同时上调 κ-阿片受体），且不会改变受体的亲和力。 <sup data-ref="565">565</sup> 与此相辅相成的是，DMSO 还能实现阿片类药物的局部给药。 当吗啡或脑啡肽类似物溶解于二甲基亚砜并局部涂抹于小鼠尾部时，它们产生了强效的、剂量依赖性的镇痛作用，且未检测到全身吸收；重复给药仅诱导局部（而非全身）耐受性，且该耐受性可被NMDA拮抗剂阻断。 <sup data-ref="565">565</sup> 这表明二甲基亚砜能够实现靶向局部阿片类镇痛，同时避免了导致慢性阿片类药物使用问题严重的全身性副作用、耐受性和成瘾性。

content.en: Together, these findings may suggest DMSO enhances endogenous opioid signaling at both the peptide and receptor level, potentially benefitting chronic opioid users whose endorphin production has been downregulated while also offering some of the benefits of LDN therapy to chronically ill patients.
content.cn: 综合来看，这些研究结果可能表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能在肽和受体两个层面增强内源性阿片类物质的信号传导，这不仅可能惠及因内啡肽分泌受抑制的慢性阿片类药物使用者，还能为慢性病患者带来低剂量纳洛酮（LDN）疗法的一些益处。

content.en: *Note: from the start, DMSO was recognized to potentiate insulin (making diabetics require lower insulin doses to avoid hypoglycemia), and this effect is frequently postulated to result from DMSO’s protein stabilizing qualities making insulin receptors more sensitive to insulin (**suggesting it could do the same for opioid receptors**). However, while studies show DMSO can promote insulin secretion,<sup data-ref="566">566</sup>, <sup data-ref="567">567</sup> and the disassembly of insulin amyloid fibrils,<sup data-ref="568">568</sup>, <sup data-ref="569">569</sup>03334-7), <sup data-ref="568">568</sup> I have not found any studies showing it improves receptor function (rather, only ones that show in combination with another agent such as resveratrol, ginger, DHC, allicin or DHEA that insulin sensitivity is increased <sup data-ref="570">570</sup>, <sup data-ref="571">571</sup>, <sup data-ref="572">572</sup>, <sup data-ref="573">573</sup>, <sup data-ref="574">574</sup>, <sup data-ref="575">575</sup>, <sup data-ref="576">576</sup>, <sup data-ref="577">577</sup>, <sup data-ref="578">578</sup> or that at higher concentrations DMSO impairs insulin binding <sup data-ref="579">579</sup>).
content.cn: 注：从一开始，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）就被认为具有增强胰岛素作用的效果（使糖尿病患者在避免低血糖的情况下所需胰岛素剂量降低），人们通常推测这种效果源于DMSO的蛋白质稳定特性，该特性使胰岛素受体对胰岛素更为敏感（这表明它对阿片受体可能也有同样的作用）。 然而，尽管研究表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够促进胰岛素分泌， <sup data-ref="579">579</sup> <sup data-ref="571">571</sup> 并能分解胰岛素淀粉样纤维， <sup data-ref="579">579</sup> <sup data-ref="571">571</sup> <sup data-ref="572">572</sup> 但我尚未发现任何研究表明它能改善受体功能（相反，仅有研究显示，当与白藜芦醇、生姜、DHC、大蒜素或DHEA等其他物质联合使用时，胰岛素敏感性会提高 <sup data-ref="579">579</sup> <sup data-ref="571">571</sup> <sup data-ref="572">572</sup> <sup data-ref="573">573</sup> <sup data-ref="574">574</sup> <sup data-ref="575">575</sup> <sup data-ref="576">576</sup> <sup data-ref="577">577</sup> <sup data-ref="578">578</sup> 或者表明高浓度的二甲基亚砜会阻碍胰岛素结合 <sup data-ref="579">579</sup> ）。*

content.en: DMSO also directly counteracts the paradoxical pain sensitization that develops with chronic opioid use. In a morphine-induced hyperalgesia model, DMSO inhibited thermal hyperalgesia by reducing spinal dorsal horn TNF-α expression.<sup data-ref="580">580</sup>, <sup data-ref="581">581</sup> A large number of agents dissolved in DMSO have similarly been shown to reverse opioid-induced hyperalgesia, tolerance, and withdrawal across numerous animal models (such as β-elemene⬖ and curcumin⬖), targeting overlapping central pathways including amygdalar glutamatergic signaling, spinal NMDA receptor trafficking, and neuroinflammatory cascades.<sup data-ref="582">582</sup>, <sup data-ref="583">583</sup>, <sup data-ref="584">584</sup>, <sup data-ref="585">585</sup>, <sup data-ref="586">586</sup>, <sup data-ref="587">587</sup>, <sup data-ref="588">588</sup>, <sup data-ref="589">589</sup>, <sup data-ref="590">590</sup> GSK3 inhibitors SB216763 and SB415286 prevented morphine-induced antinociceptive tolerance and alleviated withdrawal symptoms (grooming, chewing, ptosis) without affecting other withdrawal behaviors.<sup data-ref="591">591</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能直接对抗慢性阿片类药物使用所导致的悖论性疼痛敏感化。在吗啡诱导的痛觉过敏模型中，DMSO通过降低脊髓后角的TNF-α表达，抑制了热痛觉过敏。 <sup data-ref="591">591</sup> <sup data-ref="583">583</sup> 大量溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的药物在众多动物模型中也显示出类似的功效，能够逆转阿片类药物诱导的痛觉过敏、耐受性和戒断症状（例如β-莰烯⬖和姜黄素⬖），其作用靶点涉及多个重叠的中枢通路，包括杏仁核谷氨酸能信号传导、脊髓NMDA受体的转运以及神经炎症级联反应。 <sup data-ref="591">591</sup> <sup data-ref="583">583</sup> <sup data-ref="584">584</sup> <sup data-ref="585">585</sup> <sup data-ref="586">586</sup> <sup data-ref="587">587</sup> <sup data-ref="588">588</sup> <sup data-ref="589">589</sup> <sup data-ref="590">590</sup> GSK3抑制剂SB216763和SB415286可预防吗啡诱导的抗痛觉耐受性，并缓解戒断症状 （梳理毛发、咀嚼、眼睑下垂），且未影响其他戒断行为。 <sup data-ref="591">591</sup>

content.en: Finally, opioids have been recognized to be one of the medications potentiated by DMSO (acute co-administration of 2% DMSO enhanced morphine antinociception *<sup data-ref="592">592</sup>),* potentially allowing chronic opioid users to reduce their doses. In instances where the strongest potentiation occurs (IV administration of both concurrently—which occurred during stem cell infusions), there have been reported instances in children and adults of temporary morphine overdose symptoms.<sup data-ref="593">593</sup> This opioid-potentiating effect has also been demonstrated clinically: when DMSO was added to intramuscular pethidine in patients with acute pancreatitis, it significantly enhanced pain relief, with 57% of patients pain-free within 12 hours, attributed to DMSO scavenging oxygen-derived free radicals.<sup data-ref="594">594</sup> *Note: conversely repeated higher doses of DMSO (via microinjections) was found to decrease morphine potency for at least one week (comparably to morphine tolerance).<sup data-ref="592">592</sup>*
content.cn: 最后，阿片类药物已被公认为二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可增强其药效的药物之一（急性联合给药2% DMSO可增强吗啡的抗痛觉作用 <sup data-ref="592">592</sup> ），这可能使慢性阿片类药物使用者得以减少用药剂量。在药效增强最显著的情况下（即两者同时静脉给药——这在干细胞输注过程中曾发生），已有儿童和成人出现暂时性吗啡过量症状的报道。 <sup data-ref="592">592</sup> 这种增强阿片类药物作用的效果在临床上也得到了证实：当对急性胰腺炎患者肌肉注射哌替啶时加入二甲基亚砜，其镇痛效果显著增强，57%的患者在12小时内疼痛消失，这归因于二甲基亚砜能清除氧自由基。 <sup data-ref="592">592</sup> 注：相反，研究发现反复使用较高剂量的二甲基亚砜（通过微量注射）会降低吗啡的效力，且这种影响至少持续一周（类似于吗啡耐受性）。 <sup data-ref="592">592</sup>

content.en: In short, research into DMSO’s interactions with opioids, beyond potentially benefitting opioid users, provides additional insights into how DMSO is independently able to improve a variety of chronic pain conditions.
content.cn: 简而言之，关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与阿片类药物相互作用的研究，除了可能对阿片类药物使用者带来益处外，还进一步揭示了DMSO如何能够独立地改善多种慢性疼痛病症。

content.en: Potentiation of local anesthetics
content.cn: 局部麻醉药的增效作用

content.en: DMSO significantly enhances the potency of local anesthetics,<sup data-ref="595">595</sup>, <sup data-ref="596">596</sup>, <sup data-ref="597">597</sup>, <sup data-ref="598">598</sup> potentiating lidocaine’s nerve conduction blocking effect at concentrations as low as 0.1-0.2% (where DMSO alone has no anesthetic effect), through an allosteric mechanism independent of increased intracellular drug levels.<sup data-ref="599">599</sup>, <sup data-ref="600">600</sup>, <sup data-ref="166">166</sup>, <sup data-ref="601">601</sup> In a human study, 50% DMSO alone produced partial anesthesia (numbness) to pinpricking sensation (while 20% produced a smaller reduction),<sup data-ref="602">602</sup> and long-term (but fully reversible) blockade of nerve endings and trunks can be achieved by mixing DMSO with local anesthetics at a final concentration of 30-50%.<sup data-ref="263">263</sup> In a bilateral CCI (chronic constriction injury) neuropathic pain model, intrathecal procaine dissolved in DMSO significantly improved mechanical and thermal pain thresholds while downregulating JAK2/STAT3 signaling in the spinal dorsal horn, with JAK2 overexpression reversing procaine's analgesic effect.<sup data-ref="603">603</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能显著增强局部麻醉药的效力， <sup data-ref="603">603</sup> <sup data-ref="600">600</sup> <sup data-ref="166">166</sup> <sup data-ref="601">601</sup> 即使在低至0.1%-0.2%的浓度下（此时DMSO单独使用并无麻醉作用），也能通过一种与细胞内药物浓度升高无关的别构机制，增强利多卡因对神经传导的阻断作用。 <sup data-ref="603">603</sup> <sup data-ref="600">600</sup> <sup data-ref="166">166</sup> <sup data-ref="601">601</sup> 在一项人体研究中，50%的DMSO单独使用即可对针刺感产生部分麻醉（麻木）作用（而20%的浓度仅产生较小的减弱作用）， <sup data-ref="603">603</sup> 将二甲基亚砜与局部麻醉药混合，使最终浓度达到30%-50%，可实现对神经末梢和神经干的长期（但完全可逆）阻断。 <sup data-ref="603">603</sup> 在双侧CCI（慢性压迫损伤）神经病理性疼痛模型中，溶于DMSO的普鲁卡因鞘内给药显著提高了机械痛和热痛阈值，同时下调了脊髓背角中的JAK2/STAT3信号通路；而JAK2的过表达则会逆转普鲁卡因的镇痛作用。 <sup data-ref="603">603</sup>

content.en: DMSO also markedly enhances transdermal anesthetic penetration (producing higher skin concentrations, greater flux, and shorter lag times compared to other vehicles.<sup data-ref="604">604</sup> This penetration-enhancing property led to the early development of tetracaine dissolved in DMSO for topical skin anesthesia,<sup data-ref="605">605</sup>, <sup data-ref="606">606</sup> which did not gain widespread dermal use due to the temporary skin irritation DMSO can cause. However, it found a niche in otology as myringotomies (e.g., for ear tubes) first require the painful injection of an anesthetic into the eardrum (which is avoided with a topical DMSO application), with one paper reporting this combination was well tolerated and effective in 164 cases (with tetracaine inducing anesthesia within 10 minutes).<sup data-ref="607">607</sup>, <sup data-ref="608">608</sup>, <sup data-ref="609">609</sup>50562-8/fulltext#con) *Note: DMSO has also been listed among injectable solutions (alongside lidocaine, procaine, corticosteroids, and B vitamins) for trigger point therapy.<sup data-ref="610">610</sup>*
content.cn: DMSO 还能显著增强麻醉药的经皮渗透（与其他载体相比，可产生更高的皮肤浓度、更大的通量以及更短的滞后时间）。 <sup data-ref="610">610</sup> 这一增强渗透的特性促使人们早期就开发出溶于 DMSO 的四卡因用于皮肤局部麻醉， <sup data-ref="610">610</sup> <sup data-ref="608">608</sup> 但由于 DMSO 可能会引起暂时性的皮肤刺激，该方法并未在皮肤应用中得到广泛使用。 然而，它在耳科领域找到了应用空间，因为鼓膜切开术（例如放置耳管）通常需要先向鼓膜注射麻醉剂（这会引起疼痛，而局部使用DMSO可避免此步骤）；有篇论文报道，在164例病例中，这种组合耐受性良好且有效（四卡因可在10分钟内起麻醉作用）。 <sup data-ref="610">610</sup> <sup data-ref="608">608</sup> <sup data-ref="609">609</sup> 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被列入用于触发点疗法的注射液清单（与利多卡因、普鲁卡因、皮质类固醇和B族维生素并列）。 <sup data-ref="610">610</sup>

content.en: In one trial, topical DMSO combined with lidocaine provided effective analgesia during extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy (outperforming EMLA cream with lower pain scores and fewer interruptions from intolerable pain,<sup data-ref="611">611</sup> offering a cost-effective alternative to opioids and injectable analgesics while reducing the need for general anesthesia.<sup data-ref="612">612</sup> In another, topical lidocaine in DMSO-ethanol safely achieved 51% anesthesia during pulsed dye laser treatment of vascular malformations.<sup data-ref="613">613</sup> Likewise, in veterinary practice, topical bupivacaine-DMSO applied to trimmed chicken beaks improved feed intake compared to untreated birds,<sup data-ref="614">614</sup>
content.cn: 在一项试验中，外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合利多卡因在体外冲击波碎石术期间提供了有效的镇痛效果（表现优于EMLA乳膏，疼痛评分更低，因无法忍受的疼痛而中断治疗的情况更少， <sup data-ref="614">614</sup> 不仅为阿片类药物和注射用镇痛药提供了一种经济高效的替代方案，还减少了对全身麻醉的需求。 <sup data-ref="614">614</sup> 在另一项试验中，在脉冲染料激光治疗血管畸形时，DMSO-乙醇溶液中的局部利多卡因安全地实现了51%的麻醉效果。 <sup data-ref="614">614</sup> 同样，在兽医临床实践中，将布比卡因-DMSO溶液涂抹于修剪过的鸡喙上，与未处理的鸡相比，可提高采食量， <sup data-ref="614">614</sup>

content.en: *Note: DMSO was anticipated as a dedicated nerve pain drug by Searle, but its development was halted by the FDA.<sup data-ref="615">615</sup>
content.cn: 注：塞尔公司曾将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）视为一种专门用于治疗神经痛的药物，但其研发工作被美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）叫停。 <sup data-ref="615">615</sup>*

content.en: Unusual Pain Types
content.cn: 不寻常的疼痛类型

content.en: DMSO also treats a variety of pain types that are challenging to treat with conventional options. For example, extensive evidence and numerous reader testimonials <sup data-ref="616">616</sup>, <sup data-ref="617">617</sup>, <sup data-ref="618">618</sup> show DMSO treats cancer bone metastasis pain.<sup data-ref="6">6</sup> Likewise, in 21 patients with acute alcohol-induced pancreatitis [rectal DMSO](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamasurgery/article-abstract/595169) (500 mg every 8 hours) achieved complete pain relief within 12 hours in 57% of patients (vs. 17% controls) and within 24 hours in 100% (vs. 52% controls), enabling hospital discharge after 3 days vs. only 22% of controls by day 5.<sup data-ref="619">619</sup>, <sup data-ref="620">620</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还可治疗多种常规疗法难以治愈的疼痛类型。例如，大量证据和众多读者反馈 <sup data-ref="619">619</sup> <sup data-ref="620">620</sup> <sup data-ref="618">618</sup> 表明，DMSO可缓解癌症骨转移引起的疼痛。 <sup data-ref="619">619</sup> 同样， 在一项针对21例急性酒精性胰腺炎患者的临床研究中，经直肠给药的二甲基亚砜（每8小时500毫克）使57%的患者在12小时内完全缓解疼痛（对照组为17%），100%的患者在24小时内完全缓解（对照组为52%），使患者能在3天后出院，而对照组中仅有22%的患者能在第5天出院。 <sup data-ref="619">619</sup> <sup data-ref="620">620</sup>

content.en: Likewise, one author reported DMSO treating challenging phantom limb pain,<sup data-ref="621">621</sup> and readers here have as well,<sup data-ref="622">622</sup>, <sup data-ref="623">623</sup>, <sup data-ref="624">624</sup> including a wheelchair-confined amputee (due to previous strokes and vascular issues) who had a complete resolution of the pain.<sup data-ref="622">622</sup> Similarly, DMSO has been consistently observed to treat the severe neuropathic pain quadraplegics frequently experience (which is why Jackson’s mother felt it was so noteworthy he did not need to take any pain medications).
content.cn: 同样，有位作者曾报道二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可治疗顽固性幻肢痛， <sup data-ref="622">622</sup> 本专栏的读者也有类似反馈， <sup data-ref="622">622</sup> <sup data-ref="623">623</sup> <sup data-ref="624">624</sup> 其中包括一位因既往中风和血管问题而不得不依靠轮椅生活的截肢者，其疼痛症状已完全消失。 <sup data-ref="622">622</sup> 同样，研究一致表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可治疗四肢瘫痪患者常出现的严重神经病理性疼痛（这也正是杰克逊的母亲认为他无需服用任何止痛药这一事实如此值得注意的原因）。

content.en: Readers have also reported that DMSO was the only thing that helped other challenging types of pain, such as from polymyalgia,<sup data-ref="625">625</sup> horrific gadolinium-induced bone pain,<sup data-ref="626">626</sup> or EDS (hypermobility),<sup data-ref="627">627</sup>, <sup data-ref="628">628</sup>, <sup data-ref="282">282</sup> with one reader sharing DMSO “Gives me a chance to feel what “normal” might be like.” <sup data-ref="627">627</sup>
content.cn: 读者们还反映，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是唯一能缓解其他顽固性疼痛的方法，例如多肌痛、 <sup data-ref="627">627</sup> 由钆引起的剧烈骨痛、 <sup data-ref="627">627</sup> 或Ehlers-Danlos综合征（关节过度活动症）， <sup data-ref="627">627</sup> <sup data-ref="628">628</sup> <sup data-ref="282">282</sup> 其中一位读者分享道，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）“让我有机会体验一下‘正常’的感觉。” <sup data-ref="627">627</sup>

content.en: Clinical pain data
content.cn: 临床疼痛数据

content.en: DMSO has been used clinically for a variety of neuropathic pain conditions, most extensively, as mentioned above for complex regional pain syndrome. Additionally:
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已在临床上用于治疗多种神经病理性疼痛，其中应用最广泛的是如上所述的复杂性区域疼痛综合征。此外：

content.en: •In one study of patients with peripheral neuritis and segmental neuralgia, DMSO gave 66% a full remission and 22% a partial remission.<sup data-ref="294">294</sup>
content.cn: •在一项针对周围神经炎和节段性神经痛患者的研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使66%的患者达到完全缓解，22%的患者达到部分缓解。 <sup data-ref="294">294</sup>

content.en: •In another study, DMSO was used to treat glossalgia (burning tongue syndrome).<sup data-ref="629">629</sup>
content.cn: •在另一项研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）被用于治疗舌痛症（灼舌综合征）。 <sup data-ref="629">629</sup>

content.en: •DMSO applications are widely recommended across Russian clinical guidelines for neuralgia and neuropathic conditions, where its mechanisms are described as including inactivation of hydroxyl radicals, improvement of metabolic processes at inflammation sites, reduction of excitatory impulse conduction in peripheral neurons, and moderate fibrinolytic activity, while simultaneously enhancing the penetration of analgesic and anti-inflammatory drugs.<sup data-ref="630">630</sup>, <sup data-ref="631">631</sup>
