content.cn: •在俄罗斯关于神经痛和神经病变的临床指南中，广泛推荐使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）。指南中描述其作用机制包括：惰化羟基自由基、改善炎症部位的代谢过程、减少外周神经元中兴奋性冲动的传导，以及具有适度的纤溶活性，同时还能增强镇痛药和抗炎药的渗透性。 <sup data-ref="630">630</sup> <sup data-ref="631">631</sup>

content.en: Finally, DMSO is generally more effective for treating pain above the waist and is less likely to help larger joints (e.g., the hips, which have the smallest response—although many readers have still reported benefit there). In chronic pain patients who do not respond to topical DMSO, a lower concentration of injectable DMSO or oral DMSO often helps. In some cases, it can take weeks for chronic pain to improve, and it has been noted that for some chronic pain patients, periodic breaks (e.g., 1-2 days a week) are needed to avoid developing a tolerance to DMSO.
content.cn: 最后，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通常对治疗腰部以上的疼痛更有效，而对较大关节（例如髋关节，其反应最为微弱——尽管仍有许多读者报告称该部位也获得了改善）的帮助较小。 对于对局部外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）无反应的慢性疼痛患者，低浓度的注射用二甲基亚砜或口服二甲基亚砜通常能起到帮助作用。在某些情况下，慢性疼痛的改善可能需要数周时间，且有研究指出，部分慢性疼痛患者需要定期停用（例如每周停用1-2天），以避免对二甲基亚砜产生耐受性。

content.en: Reader Reports (Nerve Pain)
content.cn: 读者反馈（神经痛）

content.en: Readers, in turn, report DMSO relieving nerve pain from a wide variety of causes. Several described immediate or near-immediate relief: “Just started DMSO. It’s relieving chronic nerve pain,” <sup data-ref="632">632</sup> “It works for me for nerve pain,” <sup data-ref="633">633</sup> and a reader with nerve damage from a bad wreck 10 years ago found significant relief.<sup data-ref="634">634</sup> One with a pinched nerve and bursitis reported “instant relief,” <sup data-ref="364">364</sup>, <sup data-ref="347">347</sup> while a nurse with a post-surgical pinched nerve from an ankle repair found “pain was gone” overnight after combining DMSO with magnesium.<sup data-ref="635">635</sup>
content.cn: 读者们则纷纷反馈，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能缓解由多种原因引起的神经痛。有几位读者描述了立竿见影或几乎立竿见影的缓解效果：“刚开始用DMSO，它正在缓解我的慢性神经痛”， <sup data-ref="635">635</sup> “对我来说，它对神经痛很有效”， <sup data-ref="635">635</sup> 还有一位因10年前严重车祸导致神经受损的读者也感到症状显著缓解。 <sup data-ref="635">635</sup> 一位患有神经受压和滑囊炎的读者报告说“疼痛瞬间缓解”， <sup data-ref="635">635</sup> <sup data-ref="347">347</sup> 而一位因脚踝修复手术后出现神经受压的护士发现，在将二甲基亚砜与镁结合使用后，疼痛一夜之间“消失了”。 <sup data-ref="635">635</sup>

content.en: Post-Surgical Nerve Damage
content.cn: 术后神经损伤

content.en: Readers with post-surgical nerve damage reported nerve regeneration over time. A reader who lost all feeling in the back of the left arm after a 2003 lumpectomy started using DMSO on the arm: “feeling is returning. Great improvement.” <sup data-ref="484">484</sup> Another with nerve damage from ankle surgery hardware found DMSO helpful, and after hardware removal, continued using it for residual nerve effects.<sup data-ref="636">636</sup> One reader’s nerve pain from ankle surgery (six years prior) responded the first night of topical DMSO application.<sup data-ref="637">637</sup> A reader who had lymph nodes removed under the arm for breast cancer and was left with complete numbness found that after four DMSO applications, feeling returned: “I could not shave my armpit without a mirror as I could not feel anything and last night, shaving with feeling.” <sup data-ref="638">638</sup> Another with 15 years of numbness and a persistent weeping wound from a surgical incision found “both issues resolved very quickly” with DMSO.<sup data-ref="639">639</sup>
content.cn: 有术后神经损伤的读者报告称，随着时间推移，神经逐渐再生。一位读者在2003年接受乳房肿块切除术后，左臂后侧完全丧失知觉，开始在手臂上使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）：“感觉正在恢复。改善很大。” <sup data-ref="639">639</sup> 另一位因踝关节手术植入的金属固定装置导致神经损伤的读者发现DMSO很有帮助，在取出金属固定装置后，仍继续使用它来缓解残留的神经症状。 <sup data-ref="639">639</sup> 一位读者因踝关节手术（六年前）导致的神经疼痛，在使用DMSO外敷的第一晚就得到了缓解。 <sup data-ref="639">639</sup> 另一位因乳腺癌接受腋下淋巴结切除术后出现完全麻木的读者发现，在连续使用四次DMSO后，感觉恢复了： “之前我完全感觉不到腋下，没有镜子根本无法剃毛，但昨晚剃毛时已经能感觉到触感了。” <sup data-ref="639">639</sup> 还有一位读者，因手术切口导致长达15年的麻木和持续渗液的伤口，发现使用DMSO后“这两个问题都很快得到了解决”。 <sup data-ref="639">639</sup>

content.en: Post-Joint-Replacement Nerve Pain
content.cn: 关节置换术后的神经痛

content.en: Two readers reported DMSO resolving electrical pins-and-needles sensations at shoulder replacement sites. One applied DMSO along the scar “and the electrical pins and needles sensation has not returned,” <sup data-ref="640">640</sup> while another “put it there once and it went away.” <sup data-ref="641">641</sup>
content.cn: 有两位读者反映，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）缓解了肩关节置换术后部位出现的刺痛感。其中一位在疤痕处涂抹了DMSO，“刺痛感便再也没有出现过”， <sup data-ref="641">641</sup> 而另一位则表示“只涂了一次，症状就消失了”。 <sup data-ref="641">641</sup>

content.en: Burning Pain
content.cn: 灼痛

content.en: A reader’s mother with burning feet “swears by” DMSO for pain relief and has used it for years.<sup data-ref="642">642</sup> Another with burning wrist pain found DMSO “mostly taken care of it.” <sup data-ref="643">643</sup> An aircraft mechanic with severe neuropathic pain ("like an electrical shock on fire") in his palm and thumb applied DMSO topically once; the pain resolved and had not recurred over a year later despite continued daily manual work.<sup data-ref="644">644</sup>
content.cn: 一位读者的母亲因脚部灼痛而“对DMSO赞不绝口”，并已使用多年。 <sup data-ref="644">644</sup> 另一位手腕有灼痛感的读者发现，二甲基亚砜“基本解决了这个问题”。 <sup data-ref="644">644</sup> 一位飞机维修技师的手掌和拇指曾有严重的神经病理性疼痛（“就像被电击又像着火一样”），他局部涂抹了一次二甲基亚砜；疼痛随即消失，尽管之后一年多他每天仍在进行体力劳动，但疼痛再未复发。 <sup data-ref="644">644</sup>

content.en: Additional readers reported relief from pinched nerves,<sup data-ref="645">645</sup>, <sup data-ref="646">646</sup>, <sup data-ref="647">647</sup>, <sup data-ref="648">648</sup>, <sup data-ref="364">364</sup>, <sup data-ref="347">347</sup>, <sup data-ref="649">649</sup>, <sup data-ref="650">650</sup>, <sup data-ref="651">651</sup>, <sup data-ref="652">652</sup> muscle overuse,<sup data-ref="505">505</sup> and neuropathic (nerve) pain of unspecified cause,<sup data-ref="653">653</sup>, <sup data-ref="648">648</sup>, <sup data-ref="654">654</sup>, <sup data-ref="655">655</sup>, <sup data-ref="656">656</sup>, <sup data-ref="657">657</sup>, <sup data-ref="658">658</sup>, <sup data-ref="659">659</sup>, <sup data-ref="660">660</sup>,  <sup data-ref="661">661</sup>, <sup data-ref="662">662</sup>, <sup data-ref="663">663</sup>, <sup data-ref="664">664</sup>, <sup data-ref="665">665</sup>, <sup data-ref="666">666</sup>, <sup data-ref="667">667</sup>, <sup data-ref="668">668</sup>, <sup data-ref="669">669</sup>, <sup data-ref="670">670</sup>,  <sup data-ref="671">671</sup>, <sup data-ref="672">672</sup>, <sup data-ref="673">673</sup>, <sup data-ref="674">674</sup>, <sup data-ref="675">675</sup>, <sup data-ref="676">676</sup>, <sup data-ref="677">677</sup>, <sup data-ref="678">678</sup>, <sup data-ref="679">679</sup>, <sup data-ref="680">680</sup>,  <sup data-ref="681">681</sup>, <sup data-ref="682">682</sup>, <sup data-ref="683">683</sup>, <sup data-ref="684">684</sup>, <sup data-ref="685">685</sup>, <sup data-ref="652">652</sup>, <sup data-ref="686">686</sup>, <sup data-ref="687">687</sup>, <sup data-ref="687">687</sup>, <sup data-ref="492">492</sup>, <sup data-ref="480">480</sup> with many noting that nerve pain was particularly responsive to DMSO compared to other types of pain.<sup data-ref="688">688</sup>, <sup data-ref="667">667</sup>
content.cn: 还有读者反映，该产品缓解了神经受压、 <sup data-ref="688">688</sup> <sup data-ref="667">667</sup> <sup data-ref="654">654</sup> <sup data-ref="655">655</sup> <sup data-ref="656">656</sup> <sup data-ref="657">657</sup> <sup data-ref="658">658</sup> <sup data-ref="659">659</sup> <sup data-ref="651">651</sup> <sup data-ref="660">660</sup> 肌肉过度使用、 <sup data-ref="688">688</sup> 以及原因不明的神经病理性（神经）疼痛， <sup data-ref="688">688</sup> <sup data-ref="667">667</sup> <sup data-ref="654">654</sup> <sup data-ref="655">655</sup> <sup data-ref="656">656</sup> <sup data-ref="657">657</sup> <sup data-ref="658">658</sup> <sup data-ref="659">659</sup> <sup data-ref="660">660</sup> <sup>,</sup> <sup data-ref="661">661</sup> <sup data-ref="662">662</sup> <sup data-ref="663">663</sup> <sup data-ref="664">664</sup> <sup data-ref="665">665</sup> <sup data-ref="666">666</sup> <sup data-ref="667">667</sup> <sup data-ref="668">668</sup> <sup data-ref="669">669</sup> <sup data-ref="670">670</sup> <sup data-ref="671">671</sup> <sup data-ref="672">672</sup> <sup data-ref="673">673</sup> <sup data-ref="674">674</sup> <sup data-ref="675">675</sup> <sup data-ref="676">676</sup> <sup data-ref="677">677</sup> <sup data-ref="678">678</sup> <sup data-ref="679">679</sup> <sup data-ref="680">680</sup> <sup>,</sup> <sup data-ref="681">681</sup> <sup data-ref="682">682</sup> <sup data-ref="683">683</sup> <sup data-ref="684">684</sup> <sup data-ref="685">685</sup> <sup data-ref="652">652</sup> <sup data-ref="686">686</sup> <sup data-ref="687">687</sup> <sup data-ref="687">687</sup> <sup data-ref="492">492</sup> <sup data-ref="480">480</sup> 许多人指出，与其他类型的疼痛相比，神经痛对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的反应尤为显著。 <sup data-ref="688">688</sup> <sup data-ref="667">667</sup>

content.en: *Note: one reader with a “mysterious” sensory issue (burning and numbness throughout the body for 9 months, all tests negative) found only temporary improvement from topical 70% DMSO, suggesting that deeper or more systemic neurological conditions may require oral or IV administration.<sup data-ref="486">486</sup>
content.cn: 注：一位患有“神秘”感觉障碍（全身灼热和麻木持续9个月，所有检查结果均为阴性）的读者发现，外用70%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）仅能带来暂时性改善，这表明更深层或更具全身性的神经系统疾病可能需要口服或静脉注射治疗。 <sup data-ref="486">486</sup>*

content.en: Spinal Pain
content.cn: 脊柱疼痛

content.en: Nerve pain from a spinal issue (e.g., nerve root compressions and radiculopathies) is highly responsive to DMSO, with hundreds of studies and reader reports attesting to this. This extensive body of evidence is detailed in [the previous article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses) (which can be read [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses)).
content.cn: 由脊柱问题引起的神经痛（例如神经根受压和神经根病变）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的反应极佳，已有数百项研究和读者报告对此予以证实。这大量证据的详细内容已在上一篇文章中阐述（可点击此处阅读）。

content.en: Combination Studies in Neuropathic Pain Models
content.cn: 神经病理性疼痛模型中的联合研究

content.en: A large number of therapeutic agents dissolved in DMSO have demonstrated efficacy across various neuropathic pain models. For example, [one study found](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10490883/) that DMSO co-administration with the cannabinoid analgesic CT-3 (which alone produced dose-dependent analgesia comparable to morphine without GI ulceration) reduced analgesia while increasing both toxicity and ulceration.
content.cn: 大量溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗药物已在多种神经病理性疼痛模型中显示出疗效。例如，一项研究发现，将DMSO与大麻素类镇痛药CT-3（该药物单独使用时可产生与吗啡相当的剂量依赖性镇痛效果，且不会引起胃肠道溃疡）联合给药，不仅降低了镇痛效果，还同时增加了毒性和溃疡发生率。

content.en: Since DMSO served as the vehicle control in these studies, the agents’ benefits are measured against DMSO’s own baseline analgesic properties, meaning the actual therapeutic gap between treatment and no treatment is likely larger than these studies report. For example, in one study using DMSO as the vehicle for the A3 adenosine receptor agonist IB-MECA, the DMSO vehicle control group showed full reversal of mechanical allodynia in CCI rats, an effect the authors **did not comment on** but which is consistent with DMSO’s independent analgesic properties.<sup data-ref="689">689</sup>
content.cn: 由于在这些研究中DMSO被用作溶剂对照组，因此这些药物的疗效是相对于DMSO本身的基线镇痛特性来衡量的，这意味着治疗组与未治疗组之间的实际治疗差距很可能比这些研究报告的要大。 例如，在一项将二甲基亚砜用作A3腺苷受体激动剂IB-MECA载体的研究中，二甲基亚砜载体对照组显示出CCI大鼠机械性异痛症的完全逆转，尽管作者未对此效果进行评论，但这与二甲基亚砜的独立镇痛特性是一致的。 <sup data-ref="689">689</sup>

content.en: *Note: one reader cautioned against using DMSO to “transport” CBD cream: “You’ll get hit with a sledgehammer that will make you question life itself.” <sup data-ref="690">690</sup> This is consistent with DMSO’s known ability to dramatically enhance the absorption and potency of topical agents, and readers should be aware that combining DMSO with other active topical substances (including CBD, essential oils, and capsaicin) may produce effects far stronger than either alone. Conversely, topical WIN 55,212-2 (a cannabinoid agonist) enhanced topical morphine analgesia via CB1 receptor mechanisms,<sup data-ref="691">691</sup> and DMSO combined with anandamide <sup>⬖</sup> (an endogenous cannabinoid) also effectively reduced pain,<sup data-ref="692">692</sup> suggesting cannabinoid-DMSO-opioid combinations can be synergistic when properly dosed.
content.cn: 注：有位读者提醒不要使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）来“输送”CBD乳霜：“你会像被大锤狠狠砸中一样，甚至会让你对生命本身产生怀疑。” <sup data-ref="692">692</sup> 这与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能显著增强外用制剂吸收率和效力的已知特性相符，读者应注意，将DMSO与其他外用活性物质（包括CBD、精油和辣椒素）结合使用，可能产生远强于单独使用任何一种物质的效果。 相反，外用WIN 55,212-2（一种大麻素激动剂）通过CB1受体机制增强了外用吗啡的镇痛效果， <sup data-ref="692">692</sup> 而二甲基亚砜与阿南达米德 <sup>⬖</sup> （一种内源性大麻素）的组合也有效缓解了疼痛， <sup data-ref="692">692</sup> 这表明，在剂量适当的情况下，大麻素-二甲基亚砜-阿片类药物组合可产生协同作用。*

content.en: Common Neuropathic Pain Combinations
content.cn: 常见的神经病理性疼痛联合用药方案

content.en: Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> is the most extensively studied natural agent for neuropathic pain in combination with DMSO. Across CCI models, intrathecal and intraperitoneal curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> repeatedly improved mechanical and thermal pain thresholds through multiple pathways: upregulating cannabinoid receptor 1 while downregulating NMDAR2B, inhibiting the inflammatory TLR4/TNF-α/IL-1β cascade, suppressing TAK1-mediated astrocyte activation, and inhibiting spinal microglial inflammation.<sup data-ref="693">693</sup>, <sup data-ref="694">694</sup>, <sup data-ref="695">695</sup>, <sup data-ref="696">696</sup> In spared nerve injury models, curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> achieved analgesic effects comparable to pregabalin (likely through reduced CCL2 expression in dorsal root ganglia) and suppressed spinal p38 driven inflammatory cytokine signaling.<sup data-ref="697">697</sup>, <sup data-ref="698">698</sup> With forced exercise, curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> prevented peripheral nerve conduction deficits in CCI rats,<sup data-ref="699">699</sup> and in diabetic neuropathic pain, attenuated mechanical allodynia with the opioid system implicated in its mechanism.<sup data-ref="700">700</sup>
content.cn: 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 是目前研究最为广泛的一种与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合用于治疗神经病理性疼痛的天然活性物质。 在各种CCI模型中，鞘内和腹腔注射姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过多种途径反复提高了机械痛阈和热痛阈：上调大麻素受体1的同时下调NMDAR2B，抑制炎症性TLR4/TNF-α/IL-1β级联反应，抑制TAK1介导的星形胶质细胞活化，并抑制脊髓小胶质细胞炎症。 <sup data-ref="700">700</sup> <sup data-ref="698">698</sup> <sup data-ref="695">695</sup> <sup data-ref="696">696</sup> 在保留神经损伤模型中，姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 实现了与普瑞巴林相当的镇痛效果（可能通过降低背根神经节中CCL2的表达），并抑制了脊髓中由p38驱动的炎症细胞因子信号传导。 <sup data-ref="700">700</sup> <sup data-ref="698">698</sup> 在强制运动条件下，姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 预防了CCI大鼠的外周神经传导功能障碍， <sup data-ref="700">700</sup> 并在糖尿病神经病理性疼痛中减轻了机械性异痛症，其作用机制与阿片系统有关。 <sup data-ref="700">700</sup>

content.en: Resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> combinations also showed consistent benefits across neuropathic pain models. In CCI rats, intrathecal resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> attenuated thermal hyperalgesia by activating anti-inflammatory SIRT1 and reducing inflammatory acetylated NF-κB, while intracerebroventricular delivery inhibited hippocampal astrocyte activation and NF-κB expression (demonstrating that neuropathic pain involves supraspinal neuroinflammation amenable to treatment).<sup data-ref="701">701</sup>, <sup data-ref="702">702</sup>, <sup data-ref="703">703</sup> In paclitaxel-induced neuropathy, resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> increased spinal SIRT1 and improved mechanical pain thresholds.<sup data-ref="704">704</sup> Sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> and resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> together produced synergistic analgesia in an orofacial formalin pain model at doses lower than either agent alone required for equivalent effect.<sup data-ref="705">705</sup>
content.cn: 白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 复方制剂在各种神经病理性疼痛模型中也表现出一致的疗效。 在CCI大鼠模型中，鞘内给药的白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活抗炎因子SIRT1并降低炎症性乙酰化NF-κB，从而减轻了热痛觉过敏；而脑室给药则抑制了海马区星形胶质细胞的活化和NF-κB的表达（这表明神经病理性疼痛涉及可治疗的脊髓上段神经炎症）。 <sup data-ref="705">705</sup> <sup data-ref="702">702</sup> <sup data-ref="703">703</sup> 在紫杉醇诱导的神经病变中，白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 增加了脊髓中的 SIRT1 水平，并提高了机械痛阈值。 <sup data-ref="705">705</sup> 在口面部福尔马林疼痛模型中，硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 与白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用时，其镇痛作用呈现协同效应，且所需剂量低于单独使用任一药物达到同等效果所需的剂量。 <sup data-ref="705">705</sup>

content.en: Numerous p38 MAPK inhibitors reduced neuropathic pain across virtually every model tested, including CCI (reducing P2X7 and P2Y13 receptor expression, suppressing COX-2, and inhibiting microglial inflammation),<sup data-ref="706">706</sup>, <sup data-ref="707">707</sup>, <sup data-ref="708">708</sup>, <sup data-ref="709">709</sup> spinal nerve ligation (attenuating allodynia and hyperalgesia both preventively and in established pain),<sup data-ref="710">710</sup> ventral rhizotomy,<sup data-ref="710">710</sup> diabetic neuropathy (alleviating hyperalgesia and reducing P2X7/TRPV1/PKCε signaling),<sup data-ref="711">711</sup>, <sup data-ref="712">712</sup> and nucleus pulposus-induced radicular pain.<sup data-ref="713">713</sup> One, licochalcone A <sup>⬖</sup> achieved comparable p38/NF-κB inhibition and microglial suppression in CCI rats.<sup data-ref="707">707</sup>
content.cn: 多种p38 MAPK抑制剂在几乎所有测试模型中均减轻了神经病理性疼痛，包括CCI模型（通过降低P2X7和P2Y13受体的表达、抑制COX-2以及抑制小胶质细胞炎症）， <sup data-ref="707">707</sup> <sup data-ref="712">712</sup> <sup data-ref="708">708</sup> <sup data-ref="709">709</sup> 脊神经结扎（在预防阶段和已确立的疼痛阶段均可减轻异痛症和痛觉过敏）， <sup data-ref="707">707</sup> 腹侧根切断术、 <sup data-ref="707">707</sup> 糖尿病神经病变（缓解痛觉过敏并降低P2X7/TRPV1/PKCε信号传导）、 <sup data-ref="707">707</sup> <sup data-ref="712">712</sup> 以及髓核诱发的神经根痛。 <sup data-ref="707">707</sup> 其中，甘草查尔酮A <sup>⬖</sup> 在CCI大鼠模型中实现了与之相当的p38/NF-κB抑制作用及小胶质细胞抑制作用。 <sup data-ref="707">707</sup>

content.en: CCI (chronic constriction injury) modelsCCI（
content.cn: 慢性压迫性损伤）模型

content.en: Among natural compounds, 1,8-cineole <sup>⬖</sup> (the primary component of eucalyptus oil) dose-dependently alleviated neuropathic pain and inhibited P2X3 and P2X2 receptor overexpression in dorsal root ganglia and spinal cord across three studies.<sup data-ref="714">714</sup>, <sup data-ref="715">715</sup>, <sup data-ref="716">716</sup> Cardamonin <sup>⬖</sup> exerted antiallodynic and antihyperalgesic effects (counteracting excessive sensitivity to pain) comparable or superior to amitriptyline through central and peripheral opioidergic system activation.<sup data-ref="717">717</sup> Additional natural agents improving pain thresholds in CCI models include astragalin <sup>⬖</sup> (which inhibited P2X4/ERK1/2/TNF-R1 signaling and glial activation),<sup data-ref="718">718</sup> luteolin <sup>⬖</sup> (via the sirt1/FOXO1 pathway),<sup data-ref="719">719</sup> carnosic acid <sup>⬖</sup> (via Sirt1/p66shc),<sup data-ref="720">720</sup> and tetramethylpyrazine <sup>⬖</sup> (which dose-dependently inhibited non-L-type calcium currents in dorsal root ganglion neurons).<sup data-ref="721">721</sup> Silymarin <sup>⬖</sup> produced significant antinociception with a favorable safety profile and low cost.<sup data-ref="722">722</sup> Cimifugin <sup>⬖</sup> (from Saposhnikovia) reduced formalin-induced flinch responses dose-dependently, with ED50 values of 696 μg for acute pain and 1,243 μg for inflammatory pain.<sup data-ref="723">723</sup>
content.cn: 在天然化合物中，三项研究均表明，1,8-桉叶素 <sup>⬖</sup> （桉树油的主要成分）能以剂量依赖性方式缓解神经病理性疼痛，并抑制背根神经节和脊髓中P2X3和P2X2受体的过表达。 <sup data-ref="723">723</sup> <sup data-ref="715">715</sup> <sup data-ref="716">716</sup> 豆蔻酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活中枢和外周阿片能系统，发挥了与阿米替林相当或更优的抗异痛和抗痛觉过敏作用（抵消对疼痛的过度敏感）。 <sup data-ref="723">723</sup> 其他可在CCI模型中提高疼痛阈值的天然活性物质包括蒺藜素 <sup>⬖</sup> （其抑制了P2X4/ERK1/2/TNF-R1信号传导和胶质细胞活化）、 <sup data-ref="723">723</sup> 木犀草素 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过sirt1/FOXO1通路）， <sup data-ref="723">723</sup> 肉豆蔻酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过 Sirt1/p66shc 途径）， <sup data-ref="723">723</sup> 以及四甲基吡嗪 <sup>⬖</sup> （其以剂量依赖性方式抑制了背根神经节神经元中的非 L 型钙电流）。 <sup data-ref="723">723</sup> 水飞蓟素 <sup>⬖</sup> 具有显著的抗痛觉作用，且安全性良好、成本低廉。 <sup data-ref="723">723</sup> 西米福金 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自沙棘）以剂量依赖性方式减轻了福尔马林诱导的畏缩反应，其ED50值在急性疼痛中为696 μg，在炎症性疼痛中为1,243 μg。 <sup data-ref="723">723</sup>

content.en: CB2 receptor agonists (AM1241) consistently improved mechanical and thermal thresholds in CCI rats across multiple studies, operating through suppression of purinergic receptor signaling (P2X4, P2X7, P2Y12, P2Y13), p38 MAPK/NF-κB pathways, and BDNF, with microRNA-124-3p identified as a mediating mechanism.<sup data-ref="724">724</sup>, <sup data-ref="725">725</sup>, <sup data-ref="726">726</sup> The synthetic cannabinoid CP55940 similarly dose-dependently suppressed neuropathic pain through CB1 and CB2 receptor activation, inhibiting PKA upregulation, reducing P2X2R and P2X3R expression in dorsal root ganglia, and suppressing intracellular calcium increases in cultured DRG neurons.<sup data-ref="727">727</sup>, <sup data-ref="728">728</sup>, <sup data-ref="729">729</sup>, <sup data-ref="730">730</sup>
content.cn: 多项研究表明，CB2受体激动剂（AM1241）能持续提高CCI大鼠的机械痛阈和热痛阈，其作用机制在于抑制嘌呤能受体信号传导（P2X4、P2X7、P2Y12、P2Y13）、p38 MAPK/NF-κB信号通路以及脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF），其中微RNA-124-3p被确认为其介导机制。 <sup data-ref="727">727</sup> <sup data-ref="728">728</sup> <sup data-ref="729">729</sup> 合成大麻素CP55940同样通过激活CB1和CB2受体，以剂量依赖性方式抑制神经病理性疼痛，其作用机制包括抑制PKA上调、降低背根神经节中P2X2R和P2X3R的表达，以及抑制培养的背根神经节神经元中细胞内钙浓度的升高。 <sup data-ref="727">727</sup> <sup data-ref="728">728</sup> <sup data-ref="729">729</sup> <sup data-ref="730">730</sup>

content.en: Riluzole attenuated mechanical allodynia and induced long-term depression of C and Aδ fiber-evoked excitatory postsynaptic currents in spinal dorsal horn neurons, while also downregulating P2X7 receptor expression and inhibiting microglial activation through a mechanism distinct from sodium channel blockade.<sup data-ref="731">731</sup>, <sup data-ref="732">732</sup>, <sup data-ref="733">733</sup> Necrostatin-1 improved mechanical and thermal thresholds by inhibiting the RIP1/RIP3/MLKL necroptosis pathway and reducing IL-1β, TNF-α, and IL-6.<sup data-ref="734">734</sup>
content.cn: 利鲁唑减轻了机械性异痛，并诱导了脊髓背角神经元中C纤维和Aδ纤维诱发的兴奋性突触后电流的长期抑制，同时通过一种与钠通道阻断不同的机制下调了P2X7受体的表达并抑制了小胶质细胞的活化。 <sup data-ref="734">734</sup> <sup data-ref="732">732</sup> <sup data-ref="733">733</sup> 奈克罗司汀-1 通过抑制 RIP1/RIP3/MLKL 坏死性凋亡通路并降低 IL-1β、TNF-α 和 IL-6 的水平，提高了机械和热痛阈值。 <sup data-ref="734">734</sup>

content.en: Additional pharmaceutical agents showing analgesic effects in CCI models include an ERK1/2 inhibitor (U0126, which attenuated neuropathic pain and VEGF/ERK/CREB signaling across multiple studies),<sup data-ref="735">735</sup>, <sup data-ref="736">736</sup>, <sup data-ref="737">737</sup>, <sup data-ref="738">738</sup>, <sup data-ref="739">739</sup> an aquaporin 4 inhibitor (TGN-020, which inhibited ERK/JNK/p38 MAPK signaling),<sup data-ref="740">740</sup>, <sup data-ref="741">741</sup> a Sigma-1 receptor antagonist (BD-1047, which modulated P2X3 receptor co-expression in DRG neurons),<sup data-ref="742">742</sup> wortmannin (which alleviated pain via PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway inhibition and microglial suppression),<sup data-ref="743">743</sup> a caspase-1 inhibitor (VX-765, which reduced spinal NLRP1 and IL-1β),<sup data-ref="744">744</sup> and a monocarboxylate transporter inhibitor (4-CIN, which completely prevented neuropathic pain development).<sup data-ref="745">745</sup> Additional agents reducing pain thresholds through glial or inflammatory suppression include a GSK3β inhibitor and eIF2α agonist (reduced ER stress in DRG),<sup data-ref="746">746</sup> a STAT3 inhibitor (WP1066),<sup data-ref="747">747</sup> pioglitazone (suppressed astrocyte activation and inflammatory cytokines via PPARγ),<sup data-ref="748">748</sup> roscovitine (a CDK5 inhibitor that suppressed astrocyte activation),<sup data-ref="749">749</sup> a PKCε inhibitor (BIM I, which reduced astrocyte-mediated central pain sensitization),<sup data-ref="750">750</sup> a MIF antagonist (ISO-1, which suppressed TNF-α and IL-1β in DRG),<sup data-ref="751">751</sup> a GABA transporter 3 inhibitor (transiently improved pain thresholds by targeting GAT3 upregulation in DRG),<sup data-ref="752">752</sup> liproxstatin-1 (mitigated ferroptosis in DRG Schwann cells and astrocytes),<sup data-ref="753">753</sup> a HO-1 agonist (cobalt protoporphyrin IX, which increased μ-opioid receptor expression),<sup data-ref="754">754</sup> astaxanthin <sup>⬖</sup> (elevated HO-1 and antioxidant enzymes while reducing inflammatory cytokines),<sup data-ref="755">755</sup> a CB1 agonist (AM841),<sup data-ref="756">756</sup> PKA/CaMKII/HCN4 pathway inhibitors,<sup data-ref="757">757</sup> dual σ1/μ opioid receptor small molecules,<sup data-ref="758">758</sup> a PKC inhibitor (which reduced P2X3R expression),<sup data-ref="759">759</sup> and triptolide <sup>⬖</sup> (which suppressed T cell activation and spinal inflammation without motor dysfunction).<sup data-ref="760">760</sup>
content.cn: 在CCI模型中表现出镇痛作用的其他药物还包括一种ERK1/2抑制剂（U0126，多项研究表明其可减轻神经病理性疼痛并抑制VEGF/ERK/CREB信号传导）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> <sup data-ref="741">741</sup> <sup data-ref="737">737</sup> <sup data-ref="738">738</sup> <sup data-ref="739">739</sup> 一种水通道蛋白4抑制剂（TGN-020，该药物抑制了ERK/JNK/p38 MAPK信号通路）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> <sup data-ref="741">741</sup> 一种Sigma-1受体拮抗剂（BD-1047，可调节DRG神经元中P2X3受体的共表达）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 沃特曼宁（通过抑制PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路及抑制小胶质细胞活性来缓解疼痛）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种caspase-1抑制剂（VX-765，可降低脊髓中NLRP1和IL-1β的水平）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 以及一种单羧酸转运体抑制剂（4-CIN，可完全阻止神经病理性疼痛的发生）。 <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 其他通过抑制胶质细胞或炎症反应来降低疼痛阈值的药物包括一种GSK3β抑制剂和一种eIF2α激动剂（可减轻DRG中的内质网应激）、 <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种STAT3抑制剂（WP1066）、 <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 吡格列酮（通过PPARγ抑制星形胶质细胞活化和炎症细胞因子）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 罗斯科维汀（一种抑制星形胶质细胞活化的CDK5抑制剂）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种PKCε抑制剂（BIM I，可减轻星形胶质细胞介导的中枢疼痛敏感化）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种MIF拮抗剂（ISO-1，可抑制DRG中的TNF-α和IL-1β）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种GABA转运蛋白3抑制剂（通过靶向DRG中GAT3的上调，暂时提高了疼痛阈值）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 利普罗克司他汀-1（减轻了DRG施万细胞和星形胶质细胞中的铁死亡）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种HO-1激动剂（钴原卟啉IX，可增加μ-阿片受体的表达）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 虾青素 <sup>⬖</sup> （在降低炎性细胞因子的同时，提高了HO-1和抗氧化酶的水平）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种CB1激动剂（AM841）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> PKA/CaMKII/HCN4通路抑制剂， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 双重σ1/μ阿片受体小分子药物， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 一种PKC抑制剂（可降低P2X3R的表达）， <sup data-ref="760">760</sup> 以及三萜醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可在不引起运动功能障碍的情况下抑制T细胞活化和脊髓炎症）。 <sup data-ref="760">760</sup>

content.en: SNL (spinal nerve ligation) modelsSNL（
content.cn: 脊神经结扎）模型

content.en: Koumine <sup>⬖</sup> (from Gelsemium) dose-dependently reversed mechanical allodynia by acting as a positive allosteric modulator of the translocator protein (TSPO) on spinal astrocytes, stimulating pregnenolone and allopregnanolone production; in a separate study, its analgesic effect was mediated by upregulating spinal 3α-HSD expression, increasing local neurosteroid synthesis.<sup data-ref="761">761</sup>, <sup data-ref="762">762</sup> Sec-O-glucosylhamaudol <sup>⬖</sup> (from coastal hog fennel) alleviated mechanical allodynia by inhibiting the p38/JNK MAPK and NF-κB pathways and reducing autophagy, with antinociceptive effects reversed by naloxone (indicating μ-opioid receptor involvement).<sup data-ref="763">763</sup>, <sup data-ref="764">764</sup> Tetrahydropalmatine <sup>⬖</sup> significantly increased mechanical and thermal pain thresholds at medium and high doses.<sup data-ref="765">765</sup>
content.cn: 库敏 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自金丝桃）通过作为脊髓星形胶质细胞上转运蛋白（TSPO）的正向别构调节剂，刺激孕烯醇酮和异孕烯醇酮的生成，从而以剂量依赖性方式逆转了机械性异痛症； 在另一项研究中，其镇痛作用是通过上调脊髓中3α-羟基甾酮脱氢酶（3α-HSD）的表达，从而增加局部神经类固醇的合成来实现的。 <sup data-ref="765">765</sup> <sup data-ref="764">764</sup> Sec-O-葡萄糖基哈马多尔 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自海岸猪茴香）通过抑制 p38/JNK MAPK 和 NF-κB 信号通路以及减少自噬来缓解机械性异痛症，其抗痛觉作用可被纳洛酮逆转（表明与 μ-阿片受体有关）。 <sup data-ref="765">765</sup> <sup data-ref="764">764</sup> 四氢帕马汀 <sup>⬖</sup> 在中、高剂量下显著提高了机械痛和热痛阈值。 <sup data-ref="765">765</sup>

content.en: Rapamycin was the most extensively studied pharmaceutical agent in SNL models, consistently improving pain thresholds across five studies by enhancing spinal autophagy (increasing LC3-II and Beclin-1, decreasing p62), reducing neuronal apoptosis (decreasing caspase-3, increasing NeuN), and suppressing astrocyte activation (reducing GFAP). At the molecular level, rapamycin reduced mTOR/NR2B signaling, and autophagy activation reduced spinal IL-1β, TNF-α, and reactive oxygen species via the JNK/NF-κB pathway, with NRF2 partially mediating autophagy’s regulation of ROS. Conversely, the autophagy inhibitor 3-MA worsened pain behaviors and increased neuronal apoptosis.<sup data-ref="766">766</sup>, <sup data-ref="767">767</sup>, <sup data-ref="768">768</sup>, <sup data-ref="769">769</sup>, <sup data-ref="770">770</sup>
content.cn: 雷帕霉素是SNL模型中研究最为广泛的药物，在五项研究中均通过增强脊髓自噬（增加LC3-II和Beclin-1，减少p62）、减少神经元凋亡（减少caspase-3，增加NeuN）以及抑制星形胶质细胞活化（减少GFAP），持续提高了疼痛阈值。 在分子水平上，雷帕霉素可抑制mTOR/NR2B信号传导；自噬的激活通过JNK/NF-κB通路降低了脊髓中的IL-1β、TNF-α和活性氧（ROS）水平，其中NRF2部分介导了自噬对ROS的调节。相反，自噬抑制剂3-MA则加剧了疼痛行为并增加了神经元凋亡。 <sup data-ref="766">766</sup> <sup data-ref="767">767</sup> <sup data-ref="768">768</sup> <sup data-ref="769">769</sup> <sup data-ref="770">770</sup>

content.en: Trichostatin A (TSA) and other HDAC inhibitors repeatedly attenuated mechanical allodynia in SNL and related models by reversing differential miRNA expression, upregulating BDNF, and modulating histone acetylation in the spinal cord.<sup data-ref="771">771</sup>, <sup data-ref="772">772</sup>, <sup data-ref="773">773</sup> Additional agents demonstrating efficacy in SNL models include a KDM6B inhibitor (GSK-J4, which epigenetically regulated IL-6 via H3K27me3 demethylation and STAT3 signaling),<sup data-ref="774">774</sup> a BRD4 inhibitor (I-BET762, which identified the miR-200a/c-myc/ROS axis as a regulatory mechanism),<sup data-ref="775">775</sup> a P2Y12 receptor antagonist (MRS2395, which suppressed P2X4 and p38 MAPK),<sup data-ref="776">776</sup> meloxicam (which prevented allodynia development when administered early after injury, supporting a role for COX-2 in neuropathic pain pathogenesis),<sup data-ref="777">777</sup> and an AKT inhibitor (which enhanced autophagy and provided analgesic effects by modulating the AKT/TSC2/mTOR pathway).<sup data-ref="778">778</sup> In bone cancer pain models, aspirin-triggered lipoxin significantly increased paw withdrawal threshold with analgesic duration exceeding equimolar morphine,<sup data-ref="779">779</sup> while [baicalein](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2015&filename=1014446730.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=gKLtDQwwPuk3Of_k8-BUL-d0PuQg3ahN0AYY6k2if2tILo2gW5pr1Ra99YEzZwFP) <sup>⬖</sup> (attenuated mechanical allodynia; both reduced 5-lipoxygenase and p-JNK in the spinal cord).<sup data-ref="779">779</sup>
content.cn: 三羟基苯甲酸A（TSA）和其他组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂通过逆转微RNA（miRNA）表达的差异、上调脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）以及调节脊髓中组蛋白乙酰化，在SNL及相关模型中反复减轻了机械性异痛症。 <sup data-ref="779">779</sup> <sup data-ref="772">772</sup> <sup data-ref="773">773</sup> 在SNL模型中显示出疗效的其他药物还包括一种KDM6B抑制剂（GSK-J4，其通过H3K27me3去甲基化和STAT3信号传导对IL-6进行表观遗传调控）， <sup data-ref="779">779</sup> 一种BRD4抑制剂（I-BET762，其揭示了miR-200a/c-myc/ROS轴作为调控机制）， <sup data-ref="779">779</sup> 一种P2Y12受体拮抗剂（MRS2395，其抑制了P2X4和p38 MAPK）， <sup data-ref="779">779</sup> 美洛昔康（在损伤后早期给药可预防异痛症的发生，支持COX-2在神经病理性疼痛发病机制中的作用）， <sup data-ref="779">779</sup> 以及一种AKT抑制剂（通过调节AKT/TSC2/mTOR通路增强自噬并产生镇痛效应）。 <sup data-ref="779">779</sup> 在骨癌疼痛模型中，阿司匹林诱导的脂氧素显著提高了足部撤回阈值，其镇痛持续时间超过了等摩尔量的吗啡， <sup data-ref="779">779</sup> 而黄芩素 <sup>⬖</sup> （减轻了机械性异痛症；两者均降低了脊髓中的5-脂氧合酶和p-JNK水平）。 <sup data-ref="779">779</sup>

content.en: *Note: garcinol (a p300 acetyltransferase inhibitor) reduced thermal hyperalgesia and suppressed NF-κB pathway activation via reduced p300-mediated acetylation of p65 in SNL rats.<sup data-ref="780">780</sup>, <sup data-ref="781">781</sup> A TRPM8 blocker (AMTB) reversed both cold hyperalgesia and mechanical hyperalgesia in SNI rats while simultaneously restoring scratching behavior suppressed by nerve injury, revealing that neuropathic pain and itch share overlapping spinal mechanisms.<sup data-ref="782">782</sup> Among agents combined with DMSO for spinal nerve injury models,* *[a TSPO agonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=ZTYZ201505009&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=f3eduwCM3imWhwBLU5f9a8Orjk-dobJCTbV3zcg_zDyfZrRUwOQ_SNMmIfnEFgok)* *(Ro5-4864) reduced spinal astrocyte activation (GFAP) and TNF-α for up to 21 days after nerve injury,<sup data-ref="783">783</sup>* *tetramethylpyrazine <sup>⬖</sup> inhibited non-L-type calcium currents in dorsal root ganglion neurons,<sup data-ref="721">721</sup>* *a p38 MAPK inhibitor* *reduced spinal p-p38 and serum IL-6 while upregulating glucocorticoid receptors,<sup data-ref="784">784</sup> and* *rufinamide* *selectively suppressed C-fiber (but not Aδ-fiber) excitatory transmission in spinal substantia gelatinosa neurons.<sup data-ref="785">785</sup>*
content.cn: 注：加尔西诺尔（一种p300乙酰转移酶抑制剂）通过减少p300介导的p65乙酰化，减轻了SNL大鼠的热痛觉过敏，并抑制了NF-κB通路的激活。 <sup data-ref="785">785</sup> <sup data-ref="781">781</sup> 一种 TRPM8 拮抗剂（AMTB）不仅逆转了 SNI 大鼠的冷痛觉过敏和机械痛觉过敏，同时还恢复了因神经损伤而受抑制的抓挠行为，这表明神经病理性疼痛和瘙痒在脊髓中具有重叠的机制。 <sup data-ref="785">785</sup> 在与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合用于脊髓神经损伤模型的药物中，一种TSPO激动剂（Ro5-4864）在神经损伤后长达21天内降低了脊髓星形胶质细胞的活化（GFAP）和TNF-α水平， <sup data-ref="785">785</sup> 四甲基吡嗪 <sup>⬖</sup> 抑制了背根神经节神经元中的非L型钙电流， <sup data-ref="785">785</sup> 一种p38 MAPK抑制剂在降低脊髓p-p38和血清IL-6水平的同时，上调了糖皮质激素受体， <sup data-ref="785">785</sup> 而鲁菲那米德则选择性地抑制了脊髓胶质质神经元中C纤维（但不抑制Aδ纤维）的兴奋性传导。 <sup data-ref="785">785</sup>

content.en: SNI (spared nerve injury) modelsSNI（
content.cn: 保留神经损伤）模型

content.en: In addition to the curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> and p38 inhibitor studies described above, agents improving pain thresholds in SNI models include protectin D1 (which dose-dependently increased paw withdrawal threshold via PPARγ activation while reducing TNF-α and IL-6),<sup data-ref="786">786</sup> bardoxolone methyl (an Nrf2 activator),<sup data-ref="787">787</sup> memantine (which dose-dependently attenuated mechanical hyperalgesia and allodynia via NMDA open-channel blockade at clinically tolerable doses without motor deficits often seen with this medication class),<sup data-ref="788">788</sup> and intrathecal modulators of nNOS phosphorylation sites (identifying CaMKII and Akt as key regulators of nitric oxide-mediated neuropathic pain).<sup data-ref="789">789</sup> A D2 receptor antagonist (sulpiride) partially reversed tramadol’s analgesic effect in CCI rats, demonstrating that tramadol’s pain relief operates partly through dopamine D2 receptor upregulation in the nucleus accumbens.<sup data-ref="790">790</sup> A calpain inhibitor reduced mechanical hyperalgesia in a postoperative pain model by reversing KCC2 downregulation in the spinal cord.<sup data-ref="791">791</sup>
content.cn: 除了上文所述的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和 p38 抑制剂研究外，在 SNI 模型中可提高疼痛阈值的药物还包括：protectin D1（该药物通过激活 PPARγ 以剂量依赖性方式提高了足垫撤回阈值，同时降低了 TNF-α 和 IL-6 水平）、 <sup data-ref="791">791</sup> 甲基巴多索隆（一种 Nrf2 激活剂）、 <sup data-ref="791">791</sup> 美金诺（在临床可耐受剂量下，通过阻断NMDA开放通道以剂量依赖性方式减轻机械性痛觉过敏和异痛症，且不会出现该类药物常伴随的运动功能障碍）， <sup data-ref="791">791</sup> 以及鞘内给药的nNOS磷酸化位点调节剂（证实CaMKII和Akt是一氧化氮介导的神经病理性疼痛的关键调节因子）。 <sup data-ref="791">791</sup> 一种 D2 受体拮抗剂（舒必利）在 CCI 大鼠模型中部分逆转了曲马多的镇痛作用，这表明曲马多的镇痛作用部分是通过伏隔核中多巴胺 D2 受体的上调实现的。 <sup data-ref="791">791</sup> 一种钙蛋白酶抑制剂通过逆转脊髓中KCC2的下调，减轻了术后疼痛模型中的机械性痛觉过敏。 <sup data-ref="791">791</sup>

content.en: Diabetic neuropathic pain
content.cn: 糖尿病神经病变性疼痛

content.en: Among natural compounds, berberine <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently reduced blood glucose, alleviated mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia, reduced spinal cord and DRG oxidative stress and inflammation, and upregulated μ-opioid receptor expression.<sup data-ref="792">792</sup> Osthole <sup>⬖</sup> improved pain thresholds while reducing P2X4 receptor expression, GFAP, BDNF, and p38 MAPK phosphorylation in DRG.<sup data-ref="793">793</sup> Additional agents include Urtica dioica <sup>⬖</sup> and pioglitazone (each improved oxidative stress markers and mitochondrial function while reducing pain scores),<sup data-ref="794">794</sup> a TrkB inhibitor (k252a, which significantly increased pain thresholds by decreasing BDNF and increasing KCC2 expression),<sup data-ref="795">795</sup> and PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway inhibition (which promoted spinal autophagy and improved hyperalgesia thresholds).<sup data-ref="796">796</sup> Calcitriol (vitamin D) <sup>⬖</sup> significantly increased pain tolerance in both tail flick and hot plate tests at 30 and 60 minutes.<sup data-ref="797">797</sup> Lastly, alpha-lipoic acid <sup>⬖</sup> significantly corrected established hypoalgesia (lost sensation) after 90 minutes, suggesting that once hypoalgesia develops, different therapeutic approaches are needed.<sup data-ref="798">798</sup>
content.cn: 在天然化合物中，小檗碱 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量依赖性方式降低了血糖水平，缓解了机械性及热性痛觉过敏，减轻了脊髓和DRG的氧化应激和炎症，并上调了μ-阿片受体的表达。 <sup data-ref="798">798</sup> 奥斯托尔 <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了痛阈，同时降低了DRG中P2X4受体的表达、GFAP、BDNF以及p38 MAPK的磷酸化水平。 <sup data-ref="798">798</sup> 其他药物包括二叶荨麻 <sup>⬖</sup> 和吡格列酮（二者均改善了氧化应激标志物和线粒体功能，同时降低了疼痛评分）， <sup data-ref="798">798</sup> 一种TrkB抑制剂（k252a，通过降低BDNF和增加KCC2表达显著提高了疼痛阈值）， <sup data-ref="798">798</sup> 以及PI3K/AKT/mTOR通路的抑制（该处理促进了脊髓自噬并提高了痛觉过敏阈值）。 <sup data-ref="798">798</sup> 钙三醇（维生素D） <sup>⬖</sup> 在30分钟和60分钟时，显著提高了尾部闪避试验和热板试验中的疼痛耐受性。 <sup data-ref="798">798</sup> 最后，α-硫辛酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 在90分钟后显著纠正了已形成的痛觉减退（感觉丧失），这表明一旦出现痛觉减退，就需要采取不同的治疗方法。 <sup data-ref="798">798</sup>

content.en: Chemotherapy-induced neuropathy
content.cn: 化疗引起的神经病变

content.en: Among natural compounds, glucoraphanin <sup>⬖</sup> and sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently reduced oxaliplatin-induced neuropathic pain through H₂S release and Kv7 potassium channel modulation, with daily administration preventing neuropathy development entirely.<sup data-ref="799">799</sup> Tanshinone IIA,<sup>⬖</sup> cryptotanshinone <sup>⬖</sup>, and Danshen extract <sup>⬖</sup> from Salvia miltiorrhiza alleviated oxaliplatin-induced neuropathic pain while showing selective neuroprotective effects (inhibiting glioblastoma cells with no effect on healthy cells).<sup data-ref="800">800</sup> Paeoniflorin,<sup>⬖</sup> attenuated paclitaxel-induced mechanical allodynia and demyelination via adenosine A1 receptor activation while downregulating ER stress in Schwann cells.<sup data-ref="801">801</sup> Gastrodin <sup>⬖</sup> combined with vincristine not only improved tumor inhibition rates but also dose-dependently inhibited vincristine-induced neuropathic pain by suppressing the Notch/CX3CR1/p38 pathway.<sup data-ref="802">802</sup> 4-Dimethylamino chalcone inhibited myeloperoxidase activity, produced acute antinociception via muscarinic and opioid receptors, and prevented proinflammatory macrophage polarization in vincristine-induced peripheral neuropathy.<sup data-ref="803">803</sup> Systemic cannabidiol <sup>⬖</sup> (CBD) produced antinociceptive effects in CCI neuropathic pain through peripheral μ- and δ-opioid receptor activation, with the aminopeptidase inhibitor bestatin potentiating CBD’s analgesic effects at lower doses.<sup data-ref="804">804</sup> CB2 receptor agonists in DMSO dose-dependently suppressed established paclitaxel-induced mechanical allodynia, normalizing thresholds to pre-paclitaxel baseline.<sup data-ref="805">805</sup>
content.cn: 在天然化合物中，葡萄糖萝卜硫素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和硫代葡萄糖萝卜硫素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过释放 H₂S 及调节 Kv7 钾通道，以剂量依赖性方式减轻了奥沙利铂诱导的神经病理性疼痛，且每日给药可完全预防神经病变的发生。 <sup data-ref="805">805</sup> 丹参中的丹参酮IIA、 <sup>⬖</sup> 隐丹参酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及丹参提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 不仅能缓解奥沙利铂诱导的神经病理性疼痛，还表现出选择性神经保护作用（抑制胶质母细胞瘤细胞，对健康细胞无影响）。 <sup data-ref="805">805</sup> 芍花苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活腺苷A1受体，减轻了紫杉醇诱导的机械性异痛和脱髓鞘，同时下调了施万细胞中的内质网应激。 <sup data-ref="805">805</sup> 胃苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 与长春新碱联合使用，不仅提高了肿瘤抑制率，还通过抑制 Notch/CX3CR1/p38 信号通路，以剂量依赖性方式抑制了长春新碱诱导的神经病理性疼痛。 <sup data-ref="805">805</sup> 4-二甲基氨基查尔酮可抑制髓过氧化物酶活性，通过胆碱能和阿片受体产生急性抗痛觉作用，并能防止长春新碱诱导的外周神经病变中促炎性巨噬细胞极化。 <sup data-ref="805">805</sup> 全身给药的大麻二酚 <sup>⬖</sup> (CBD) 通过激活外周μ-和δ-阿片受体，对CCI神经病理性疼痛产生抗痛觉作用，且氨基肽酶抑制剂贝斯他汀可在较低剂量下增强CBD的镇痛效果。 <sup data-ref="805">805</sup> 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的CB2受体激动剂以剂量依赖性方式抑制了已确立的紫杉醇诱导的机械性异痛症，将痛阈恢复至紫杉醇治疗前的基线水平。 <sup data-ref="805">805</sup>

content.en: Other pain models
content.cn: 其他疼痛模型

content.en: Intrathecal cannabinoid receptor agonists (anandamide <sup>⬖</sup> and WIN 55,212-2) suppressed allodynia and spontaneous pain attacks in rats with central pain syndrome, with WIN 55,212-2 producing more pronounced and longer-lasting analgesia (80% arrest rate) while high-dose intravenous anandamide <sup>⬖</sup> mitigated visceral nociception through CB1 receptor activation in sensitized rats.<sup data-ref="806">806</sup>, <sup data-ref="807">807</sup> Dexmedetomidine attenuated remifentanil-induced hyperalgesia by downregulating NR1 and NR2B subunit expression and membrane trafficking while reducing PKCγ and CaMKIIα phosphorylation in the spinal cord.<sup data-ref="808">808</sup> CDDO (a synthetic triterpenoid) exerted analgesic and neuroprotective effects in a postherpetic neuralgia model by reducing TRPV1-positive nociceptive neurons, decreasing neuronal apoptosis, reversing glial cell activation (including the first reported role of oligodendrocytes in postherpetic neuralgia), and suppressing PKC-δ and phosphorylated Akt signaling.<sup data-ref="809">809</sup> Sesamin <sup>⬖</sup> reduced both acute and chronic formalin-induced pain while downregulating TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3 inflammatory signaling in brain tissue.<sup data-ref="810">810</sup> Intraperitoneal nifedipine dissolved in DMSO produced significant dose-dependent antinociception (5-15 mg/kg) in rats, with a positive dose-response correlation suggesting involvement of spinal calcium channel mechanisms.<sup data-ref="811">811</sup> Among agents studied in bone cancer pain models, [resveratrol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUqjMaFTVS1EhYflVwuhKg6ALS38rIrr4m4os4M_I-V45bx1qv0ch1yXybazSbWZ3oEo92X5UuW_e2HJoUEKzuqe03KpieleON3k6djDhiLw8ET477qY2eVRyDpeeY0oQuJp7ivQtvLwwLrK6jLIcv9ZJTm23eseGwdc9TBpzhdO2Mok66DtgDLt&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> increased pain thresholds and modulated OPG/RANK/RANKL while decreasing TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, and CCL2,<sup data-ref="812">812</sup> [koumine](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUpY7Bv6R2k8eRJjicXa6H0QKpUhhWiiO2nWWNJ38VCXXVAXYGClckCHK9Lr0Nqmlr8HpOUmSloP8gq3P-j18avwu_2_41HIYhO95ngu773s8GLDMPuX4n195PrI7Xcl3pAhKbwukikq6olkTHwXfWGe6CkpgkO1fA0Ztq8PvNljpICKGP-bMwIV&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> decreased spinal GFAP, Iba-1, IL-6, IL-1β, and TNF-α,<sup data-ref="813">813</sup> [tanshinone IIA](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25867360/) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced spinal IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α,<sup data-ref="814">814</sup> [curcumin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=mX7l0X-lXK2DwvaSHmm5uDMKR-hYvsJMBYR9a_5BfefqHfSgkVI-cPNveLo9BJeT9R60ufdjBNvZT_-c_OcaBXbcKY7kMeYleXxm7QewhQ-Uc2kGozm9k6H1AfBRTDdcQB_QSncfRs9nl5s9A0jYLOSbGKAlm_MvXgQug1-xHD3xwcns7KOvcw==&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> elevated mechanical withdrawal threshold and reduced spinal p-CaMKII,<sup data-ref="815">815</sup> and the [CB2 agonist JWH015](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22490961/) relieved both mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia with CB2 receptor expression upregulating over time.<sup data-ref="816">816</sup>
content.cn: 蛛网膜下腔给药的大麻素受体激动剂（阿南达米德 <sup>⬖</sup> 和 WIN 55,212-2）抑制了中枢性疼痛综合征大鼠的异痛症和自发性疼痛发作，其中 WIN 55,212-2 产生的镇痛作用更为显著且持续时间更长（80% 的镇痛率）；而在敏感化大鼠中，高剂量静脉注射阿南达米德 <sup>⬖</sup> 则通过激活 CB1 受体减轻了内脏痛觉。 <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> <sup data-ref="807">807</sup> 德美沙多米丁通过下调NR1和NR2B亚基的表达及膜转运，同时降低脊髓中PKCγ和CaMKIIα的磷酸化水平，从而减轻了瑞芬太尼诱导的痛觉过敏。 <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 在带状疱疹后神经痛模型中，CDDO（一种合成三萜类化合物）通过减少TRPV1阳性痛觉神经元、降低神经元凋亡、逆转胶质细胞活化（包括首次报道的少突胶质细胞在带状疱疹后神经痛中的作用），以及抑制PKC-δ和磷酸化Akt信号传导，发挥了镇痛和神经保护作用。 <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 芝麻素 <sup>⬖</sup> 既减轻了福马林诱导的急性疼痛和慢性疼痛，又下调了脑组织中的 TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3 炎症信号传导。 <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的尼非地平腹腔注射在大鼠中产生了显著的剂量依赖性抗痛觉作用（5-15 mg/kg），其正的剂量-反应相关性表明脊髓钙通道机制参与其中。 <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 在骨癌疼痛模型中研究的各种药物中，白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了疼痛阈值，调节了OPG/RANK/RANKL的表达，同时降低了TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β和CCL2的水平， <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 莪术酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 降低了脊髓中GFAP、Iba-1、IL-6、IL-1β和TNF-α的水平， <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 丹参酮IIA <sup>⬖</sup> 降低了脊髓中IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的水平， <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了机械性痛阈，并降低了脊髓中p-CaMKII的水平， <sup data-ref="816">816</sup> 而CB2激动剂JWH015既缓解了机械性痛觉过敏，也缓解了热痛觉过敏，且CB2受体的表达随时间推移呈上调趋势。 <sup data-ref="816">816</sup>

content.en: Lastly, a Russian “Espol” ointment containing DMSO combined with capsicum extract <sup>⬖</sup> and coriander essential oil <sup>⬖</sup> was formulated for neuralgias, radiculitis, myositis, and bruises, providing hyperemia alongside analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.<sup data-ref="817">817</sup> A veterinary remedy for pain in arthritis, arthrosis, and neuralgia in dogs was formulated with DMSO, menovasin (containing menthol, procaine, and benzocaine), May honey, egg yolk, and ghee butter.<sup data-ref="818">818</sup>
content.cn: 最后，一种含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）、辣椒提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 和芫荽精油 <sup>⬖</sup> 的俄罗斯“Espol”软膏被研制出来，用于治疗神经痛、神经根炎、肌炎和挫伤，除具有镇痛和抗炎作用外，还能促进局部充血。 <sup data-ref="818">818</sup> 一种用于治疗犬类关节炎、骨关节炎和神经痛的兽用制剂，其配方包含二甲基亚砜（DMSO）、美诺瓦辛（含薄荷醇、普鲁卡因和苯佐卡因）、五月蜂蜜、蛋黄和酥油。 <sup data-ref="818">818</sup>

content.en: Fibromyalgia
content.cn: 纤维肌痛

content.en: [A Russian study](https://europepmc.org/article/med/9011284) on primary fibromyalgia syndrome found that combined therapy using DMSO with non-hormonal anti-inflammatory agents and acupuncture sessions promoted normalization of dysfunctions and was noted as “easy-to-use, available, and inexpensive.”
content.cn: 一项关于原发性纤维肌痛综合征的俄罗斯研究发现，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与非激素类抗炎药物联合使用并配合针灸治疗，有助于促进功能障碍的恢复，且被认为“使用方便、易于获得且价格低廉”。

content.en: Over the years, numerous cases of individuals with fibromyalgia having massive improvements in quality of life from DMSO have been reported, but simultaneously, quite a few cases have required starting slowly for [sensitive patients](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/constitutional-archtypes-in-medicine) with pre-existing toxicity (as otherwise the initial fluid mobilization within their body was too much for the individual—which synopsizes two of the three significant adverse reactions to DMSO I’ve seen within the roughly 10,000 reader reports I’ve reviewed).
content.cn: 多年来， 已有大量病例报告显示，纤维肌痛患者通过使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使生活质量得到了显著改善；但与此同时，对于已有毒性反应的敏感患者，不少病例需要从低剂量开始逐步增加（否则，体内初期产生的体液移动量对患者而言会过于剧烈——这概括了我审阅的约10,000份读者报告中所见到的DMSO三种主要不良反应中的两种）。

content.en: While no formal studies have been published beyond the Russian one, Stanley Jacob (whom I consider to be extremely honest) [attested](https://dmso.org/articles/fibromyalgia/fibromyalgia.htm):
content.cn: 虽然除那项俄罗斯研究外尚未发表过其他正式研究，但斯坦利·雅各布（我认为他非常诚实）证实道：

content.en: “Over the last few years, we have been treating patients with fibromyalgia. Seventy percent of the patients have experienced benefit. No serious side effects have been encountered. The properties of our regime contributing to benefit included free-radical scavenging, analgesia, anti-inflammation, softening of scar tissue, reduction of muscle spasm, and stimulation of healing.”
content.cn: “在过去的几年里，我们一直为纤维肌痛患者提供治疗。70%的患者从中获益。尚未出现任何严重副作用。我们治疗方案中有助于改善症状的特性包括：清除自由基、镇痛、抗炎、软化瘢痕组织、缓解肌肉痉挛以及促进愈合。”

content.en: *Note: Jacob’s student later published one particularly profound fibromyalgia improvement.<sup data-ref="819">819</sup>
content.cn: 注：雅各布的一位学生后来发表了一项特别有深远意义的纤维肌痛症改善案例。 <sup data-ref="819">819</sup>

content.en: *Readers, in turn, have reported DMSO’s life-changing utility for fibromyalgia. One reader, pain-free for the first time in 25 years, wrote: “I sought out DMSO and it has completely eliminated all of my pain. For reference, I’m a fibromyalgia chronic pain sufferer, in early stages of rheumatoid arthritis, with a connective tissue disorder.” <sup data-ref="820">820</sup> Numerous readers credited DMSO with eliminating or greatly reducing longstanding fibromyalgia pain,<sup data-ref="821">821</sup>, <sup data-ref="822">822</sup>, <sup data-ref="823">823</sup>, <sup data-ref="824">824</sup>, <sup data-ref="825">825</sup>, <sup data-ref="826">826</sup>, <sup data-ref="827">827</sup>, <sup data-ref="477">477</sup>, <sup data-ref="243">243</sup>, <sup data-ref="828">828</sup>, <sup data-ref="829">829</sup>, <sup data-ref="830">830</sup>, <sup data-ref="821">821</sup> with one’s mother “shocked at how quickly the pain lessened” from the 70% gel.<sup data-ref="824">824</sup>
content.cn: 读者们也纷纷反馈，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对纤维肌痛症的治疗效果堪称改变人生。一位读者在25年来首次摆脱疼痛后写道：“我尝试了二甲基亚砜，它彻底消除了我所有的疼痛。需要说明的是，我是一名纤维肌痛症慢性疼痛患者，正处于类风湿性关节炎的早期阶段，同时还患有结缔组织疾病。” <sup data-ref="824">824</sup> 许多读者都表示，正是二甲基亚砜（DMSO）消除了或大大减轻了他们长期以来的纤维肌痛， <sup data-ref="824">824</sup> <sup data-ref="822">822</sup> <sup data-ref="823">823</sup> <sup data-ref="824">824</sup> <sup data-ref="825">825</sup> <sup data-ref="826">826</sup> <sup data-ref="827">827</sup> <sup data-ref="477">477</sup> <sup data-ref="243">243</sup> <sup data-ref="828">828</sup> <sup data-ref="829">829</sup> <sup data-ref="830">830</sup> <sup data-ref="821">821</sup> 其中一位读者的母亲表示，使用70%浓度的二甲基亚砜凝胶后，“疼痛缓解得如此之快，令她大吃一惊”。 <sup data-ref="824">824</sup>

content.en: Several readers noted the importance of starting slowly with fibromyalgia. One experienced three days of feeling better followed by a return to baseline, a pattern they had seen with many treatments,<sup data-ref="831">831</sup> while another found that a three-day oral course (a small teaspoon daily) reduced pain by about 25% and made other pain protocols more effective, with no subsequent loss of efficacy.<sup data-ref="825">825</sup>
content.cn: 几位读者指出，对于纤维肌痛患者来说，循序渐进地开始治疗非常重要。其中一位读者经历了三天症状缓解，随后又恢复到原状，这种模式在许多治疗中都曾出现过， <sup data-ref="825">825</sup> 而另一位读者则发现，为期三天的口服疗程（每天一小茶匙）可将疼痛减轻约25%，并能提高其他镇痛方案的疗效，且此后疗效不会减弱。 <sup data-ref="825">825</sup>

content.en: A reader with fibromyalgia for 16 years who had been on gabapentin (which stopped working) and could not get Lyrica from the VA described remarkable results: pain in the left shoulder and blade, cervical and low back pain, knee arthritis, hip pain, scoliosis, neuropathy in both feet, and asthma all improved with topical DMSO, allowing discontinuation of multiple medications including inhalers.<sup data-ref="477">477</sup> Another reader used DMSO topically and orally and “had no fibromyalgia or pain for almost 5 years.” <sup data-ref="830">830</sup>
content.cn: 一位患有纤维肌痛症长达16年的读者，此前一直服用加巴喷丁（但已失效），且无法从退伍军人事务部（VA）获得利瑞卡，他描述了令人惊叹的效果：左肩和肩胛骨疼痛、颈部和下背部疼痛、膝关节炎、髋部疼痛、脊柱侧弯、双足神经病变以及哮喘等症状，在局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后均有所改善，从而得以停用包括吸入剂在内的多种药物。 <sup data-ref="830">830</sup> 另一位读者通过局部外用和口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO），表示“近5年来没有纤维肌痛或疼痛”。 <sup data-ref="830">830</sup>

content.en: Headaches & Migraines
content.cn: 头痛与偏头痛

content.en: Headaches are among the most common and challenging neurological complaints, and one of the conditions for which DMSO was first recognized as effective. Tension headaches (arising from muscular tension in the neck and scalp) and sinus headaches tend to respond well to DMSO, whereas migraine and cluster headaches are less consistently responsive, although some mechanistic evidence has now emerged supporting DMSO’s use in migraines.
content.cn: 头痛是最常见且最难处理的神经系统症状之一，也是二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最早被公认为有效的适应症之一。紧张性头痛（由颈部和头皮肌肉紧张引起）和鼻窦性头痛通常对二甲基亚砜反应良好，而偏头痛和丛集性头痛的反应则不那么一致，尽管目前已有一些机制证据支持将二甲基亚砜用于治疗偏头痛。

content.en: Clinical Evidence
content.cn: 临床证据

content.en: DMSO’s use for headaches has been documented since the mid-1960s. [A 1985 survey](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/00970050.1985.10614465) of DMSO users found headaches among the most commonly self-treated conditions, and papers from the early 1980s noted that DMSO was used for headaches among its many applications and [a 2005 paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19338814/) reported that migraine improvements had been attributed to DMSO.<sup data-ref="832">832</sup>, <sup data-ref="833">833</sup>, <sup data-ref="834">834</sup>
content.cn: 自20世纪60年代中期以来，已有文献记载二甲基亚砜（DMSO）用于治疗头痛。 1985年对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使用者的调查发现，头痛是人们最常自行治疗的症状之一；20世纪80年代初的论文指出，在二甲基亚砜的众多用途中，治疗头痛是其中之一；而2005年的一篇论文则报告称，偏头痛症状的改善被归因于二甲基亚砜。 <sup data-ref="832">832</sup> <sup data-ref="833">833</sup> <sup data-ref="834">834</sup>

content.en: The most comprehensive clinical data comes from Stanley Jacob, [who reported on 59 patients with headaches from a variety of causes](https://headachejournal.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1526-4610.1965.hed0503078.x), of whom over 75% responded to topical DMSO. This included 13 out of 17 patients with chronic cervical arthritis-triggered headaches (who then required gradually decreasing doses), 4 out of 5 patients with sinus headaches, both patients with temporal arteritis (complete recovery), and 26 out of 35 patients with trigeminal neuralgia of more than a year’s duration (13 achieving full recovery).
content.cn: 最全面的临床数据来自斯坦利·雅各布（Stanley Jacob），他报告了59例由各种原因引起的头痛患者，其中超过75%的患者对局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生了疗效。 其中包括17例慢性颈椎关节炎引发的头痛患者中的13例（此后需逐渐减少剂量）、5例鼻窦性头痛患者中的4例、2例颞动脉炎患者（均完全康复），以及35例病程超过一年的三叉神经痛患者中的26例（其中13例完全康复）。

content.en: *Note: [one anecdotal report describes](https://health-matrix.net/2011/03/15/dmso-the-real-miracle-solution/) a splitting headache resolving within minutes of DMSO application by Dr. Jacob, returning after four hours, and then leaving permanently after a second application.
content.cn: 注：有一则轶事报道称，雅各布医生使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，患者剧烈的头痛在几分钟内缓解，但四小时后又复发，随后在第二次使用后彻底消失。*

content.en: In a study where DMSO was found (via electromyography) to relax cervical musculature within 60 minutes of topical application, this relaxation also alleviated associated tension headaches.<sup data-ref="835">835</sup>, <sup data-ref="836">836</sup> Their combined results were as follows:
content.cn: 在一项研究中，通过肌电图发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在局部涂抹后60分钟内可使颈部肌肉放松，这种放松作用同时也缓解了相关的紧张性头痛。 <sup data-ref="835">835</sup> <sup data-ref="836">836</sup> 各项结果综合如下：

content.en: Another study of 10 patients with headaches from various causes (primarily frontal) found DMSO significantly helped all 10, including those who had had headaches for more than a day, with relief times ranging from 1 minute to about 3 hours.<sup data-ref="837">837</sup>, <sup data-ref="838">838</sup> In [a study of 15 patients](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1975.tb25389.x) with tinnitus who had concurrent headaches, DMSO produced complete headache recovery in 7, less intense headaches in 1, only occasional headaches in 2, and no response in 1.
content.cn: 另一项针对10名因各种原因（主要是额部）导致头痛的患者的研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对这10名患者均产生了显著疗效，包括那些头痛持续超过一天的患者，症状缓解时间从1分钟到约3小时不等。 <sup data-ref="837">837</sup> <sup data-ref="838">838</sup> 在一项针对15名同时伴有头痛的耳鸣患者的研究中，二甲基亚砜使其中7名患者的头痛完全缓解，1名患者的头痛程度减轻，2名患者仅偶尔出现头痛，另有1名患者未见疗效。

content.en: In [a larger observational series of 190 patients](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1967.tb34927.x) (286 conditions), topical 90% DMSO for headache and neck pain produced poor results in 59, good in 60, and excellent in 35, with better responses in tension, post-traumatic, cervical disc, and sinusitis-related cases, while vascular headaches (migraine, cluster) generally responded poorly.
content.cn: 在一项涉及190名患者（286种病症）的大型观察性研究中，外用90%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗头痛和颈部疼痛的效果表现为：59例效果不佳，60例效果良好，35例效果极佳；其中，紧张性头痛、创伤后头痛、颈椎间盘病变及与鼻窦炎相关的病例反应较好，而血管性头痛（偏头痛、丛集性头痛）的反应普遍较差。

content.en: [For sinus-associated headaches](https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/annurev.pa.12.040172.002033), 0.5 ml of 50% DMSO instilled into each nostril was found effective. [In children with headaches and cervical spine disorders](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/osobennosti-kliniki-i-terapii-golovnyh-boley-u-detey-s-funktsionalnymi-narusheniyami-pozvonochno-dvigatelnyh-segmentov-sheynogo-otdela) (105 patients aged 5-18), DMSO applications mixed with novocaine and ATP were recommended when cervicalgia was complicated by myotonic and neurodystrophic syndromes, with 10-15 applications as part of adjunctive therapy.
content.cn: 对于与鼻窦相关的头痛，将0.5毫升50%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）滴入每个鼻孔被证实有效。对于患有头痛和颈椎疾病的儿童（105名5至18岁患者），当颈痛并发肌强直综合征和神经营养不良综合征时，建议使用与诺卡因和ATP混合的DMSO进行局部治疗，作为辅助治疗的一部分，疗程为10至15次。

content.en: Lastly, it is important to remember DMSO’s headache reducing qualities often reflect it shifting systemic issues within the body. For example, [a case report](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/000331977002100304?url_ver=Z39.88-2003&rfr_id=ori:rid:crossref.org&rfr_dat=cr_pub%20%200pubmed) of a 38-year-old woman with refractory systemic lupus erythematosus documented that topical DMSO resolved severe headaches alongside dramatic improvement in skin lesions and other lupus manifestations, with sustained remission after tapering prednisone.
content.cn: 最后，需要记住的是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）缓解头痛的作用往往反映了它正在调节体内的系统性问题。例如，一份关于一名38岁女性难治性系统性红斑狼疮病例的报告显示，外用二甲基亚砜不仅缓解了严重的头痛，还显著改善了皮肤病变和其他狼疮症状，且在逐渐减量泼尼松后，病情仍保持持续缓解。

content.en: Migraine Mechanisms
content.cn: 偏头痛的发病机制

content.en: While DMSO’s clinical effects on migraines have been inconsistent, research on cortical spreading depression (CSD, the electrophysiological wave underlying migraine aura) has revealed that DMSO directly modulates the hemodynamic events thought to drive migraine headache.
content.cn: 尽管二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对偏头痛的临床疗效尚无定论，但关于皮层扩散性抑制（CSD，即偏头痛先兆背后的电生理波）的研究表明，DMSO可直接调节被认为会引发偏头痛的血流动力学事件。

content.en: [In rats](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17329631/), 10% DMSO applied to the brain interrupted the dilating vascular changes caused by CSD, likely preventing or attenuating migraine attacks. A more detailed study using laser speckle and optical intrinsic signal imaging found that topical DMSO (0.1-4%) increased resting pial arteriolar diameter and blood velocity in a dose-dependent manner while attenuating the additional hyperemic surge that accompanies CSD. The core CSD wave itself was unaffected; DMSO appeared to stabilize baseline cerebral perfusion, leaving less capacity for the exaggerated vascular overshoot thought to contribute to headache development.<sup data-ref="839">839</sup>, <sup data-ref="840">840</sup> Separately, [daily intraperitoneal lamotrigine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20977938/) in DMSO suppressed rat CSD frequency by 37-60% (depending on brain region) over four weeks, outperforming valproate and riboflavin given in saline.
content.cn: 在大鼠实验中，将10%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）涂抹于大脑，可阻断CSD引起的血管扩张变化，这可能预防或减轻偏头痛发作。 一项利用激光散斑成像和光学内源信号成像进行的更详细研究发现，局部应用二甲基亚砜（0.1%-4%）以剂量依赖性方式增加了静息状态下软脑膜小动脉的直径和血流速度，同时减弱了伴随CSD出现的额外充血峰值。CSD的核心波形本身未受影响；二甲基亚砜似乎稳定了基线脑灌注，从而减少了被认为会导致头痛发生的过度血管超调现象的发生空间。 <sup data-ref="839">839</sup> <sup data-ref="840">840</sup> 此外，在为期四周的实验中，每日腹腔注射溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的拉莫三嗪，可将大鼠CSD的发作频率抑制37%-60%（具体取决于脑区），其效果优于用生理盐水给药的丙戊酸和核黄素。

content.en: In a clinical study of 120 patients with combined migraine and cervicogenic headache, comprehensive cervical treatment including 10 topical applications of DMSO mixed with novocaine reduced migraine attack frequency by up to 50%, decreased pain intensity, and improved quality of life. An accompanying in vitro experiment using isolated rat skulls demonstrated that DMSO at 1% and 10% dose-dependently increased action potential frequency in trigeminal afferents followed by desensitization (similar to capsaicin), providing a mechanistic explanation for DMSO’s analgesic action in blocking trigeminal pain conduction relevant to headache pathogenesis.<sup data-ref="841">841</sup>, <sup data-ref="842">842</sup>, <sup data-ref="843">843</sup>
content.cn: 在一项针对120例兼有偏头痛和颈源性头痛患者的临床研究中，包括10次局部涂抹二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与诺卡因混合物在内的综合颈部治疗，使偏头痛发作频率降低了高达50%，减轻了疼痛强度，并改善了生活质量。 一项使用分离大鼠颅骨进行的配套体外实验表明，1%和10%浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会以剂量依赖性方式增加三叉神经传入纤维的动作电位频率，随后引发脱敏（类似于辣椒素的作用），这为DMSO通过阻断与头痛发病机制相关的三叉神经疼痛传导而发挥镇痛作用提供了机制上的解释。 <sup data-ref="841">841</sup> <sup data-ref="842">842</sup> <sup data-ref="843">843</sup>

content.en: *Note: I believe [blood stasis](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-makes-all-vaccines-so-dangerous) (which [DMSO addresses](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms)) plays a key role in migraines.
content.cn: 注：我认为血瘀（二甲基亚砜可针对这一问题）在偏头痛中起着关键作用。*

content.en: Reader Headache Reports
content.cn: 读者反映的头痛问题

content.en: Readers consistently reported rapid headache relief from topical DMSO (with a variety of application developed depending on the type of headache <sup data-ref="844">844</sup>, <sup data-ref="845">845</sup>, <sup data-ref="846">846</sup> such as those from an acute viral illness <sup data-ref="846">846</sup>). Many readers described headache relief, often within minutes using DMSO,<sup data-ref="847">847</sup>, <sup data-ref="848">848</sup>, <sup data-ref="849">849</sup> (e.g., “DMSO is the only thing that stops my headaches in their tracks.” <sup data-ref="849">849</sup>). A reader with chronic headaches for two years following carbon monoxide exposure found DMSO “ended the headaches within two months” when doctors had nothing for the condition.<sup data-ref="850">850</sup> Multiple readers described DMSO replacing their regular use of aspirin, NSAIDs, or other headache medications.<sup data-ref="848">848</sup>, <sup data-ref="851">851</sup>
content.cn: 读者们一致反映，外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能迅速缓解头痛（根据头痛类型的不同，有各种不同的使用方法 <sup data-ref="848">848</sup> <sup data-ref="851">851</sup> <sup data-ref="849">849</sup> ，例如由急性病毒性疾病引起的头痛 <sup data-ref="848">848</sup> ）。 许多读者描述了使用二甲基亚砜后头痛得到缓解的情况，通常仅需几分钟， <sup data-ref="848">848</sup> <sup data-ref="851">851</sup> <sup data-ref="849">849</sup> （例如：“二甲基亚砜是唯一能立马止住我头痛的东西。” <sup data-ref="848">848</sup> ）。 一位因一氧化碳中毒而持续头痛两年的读者表示，当医生对此病症束手无策时，二甲基亚砜“在两个月内就治好了头痛” <sup data-ref="848">848</sup> 。多位读者表示，二甲基亚砜已取代了他们平时使用的阿司匹林、非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）或其他头痛药物 <sup data-ref="848">848</sup> <sup data-ref="851">851</sup> 。

content.en: Notably, a physician reader applied DMSO to a physician colleague with intractable headaches that “none of the neurologists could fix,” resulting in a complete cure with no further treatment needed; their colleague had been considering quitting work because of the headaches.<sup data-ref="852">852</sup>
content.cn: 值得注意的是，一位医生读者曾为一位饱受顽固性头痛困扰的同行医生使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）——这种头痛“没有一位神经科医生能治好”——结果该患者完全痊愈，无需进一步治疗；此前，这位同行医生曾因头痛问题考虑过辞职。 <sup data-ref="852">852</sup>

content.en: Additional readers reporting (often immense) headache relief include those using DMSO for sinus headaches,<sup data-ref="853">853</sup>, <sup data-ref="854">854</sup> cluster headaches,<sup data-ref="855">855</sup> tension headaches,<sup data-ref="847">847</sup>, <sup data-ref="856">856</sup> post-concussion headaches,<sup data-ref="857">857</sup> and general chronic headaches.<sup data-ref="858">858</sup>, <sup data-ref="859">859</sup>, <sup data-ref="860">860</sup>, <sup data-ref="861">861</sup>, <sup data-ref="862">862</sup>, <sup data-ref="863">863</sup>, <sup data-ref="864">864</sup>, <sup data-ref="864">864</sup>, <sup data-ref="330">330</sup>, <sup data-ref="851">851</sup>, <sup data-ref="503">503</sup>, <sup data-ref="865">865</sup>, <sup data-ref="866">866</sup>, <sup data-ref="867">867</sup>, <sup data-ref="868">868</sup>, <sup data-ref="869">869</sup>, <sup data-ref="870">870</sup>, <sup data-ref="871">871</sup>, <sup data-ref="133">133</sup>, <sup data-ref="872">872</sup>
content.cn: 另有读者报告称，使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可显著缓解（通常是极度）头痛，包括用于治疗鼻窦性头痛、 <sup data-ref="858">858</sup> <sup data-ref="859">859</sup> 丛集性头痛、 <sup data-ref="858">858</sup> 紧张性头痛、 <sup data-ref="858">858</sup> <sup data-ref="859">859</sup> 脑震荡后头痛、 <sup data-ref="858">858</sup> 以及一般性慢性头痛。 <sup data-ref="858">858</sup> <sup data-ref="859">859</sup> <sup data-ref="860">860</sup> <sup data-ref="861">861</sup> <sup data-ref="862">862</sup> <sup data-ref="863">863</sup> <sup data-ref="864">864</sup> <sup data-ref="864">864</sup> <sup data-ref="330">330</sup> <sup data-ref="851">851</sup> <sup data-ref="503">503</sup> <sup data-ref="865">865</sup> <sup data-ref="866">866</sup> <sup data-ref="867">867</sup> <sup data-ref="868">868</sup> <sup data-ref="869">869</sup> <sup data-ref="870">870</sup> <sup data-ref="871">871</sup> <sup data-ref="133">133</sup> <sup data-ref="872">872</sup>

content.en: *Note: one reader experimented with subcutaneous DMSO injections (6.25% concentration) and reported that injection near the trapezoid produced “horrible headache the day after the injection, then a week of headache free,” suggesting a neural therapy-like reset mechanism.<sup data-ref="865">865</sup>
content.cn: 注：一位读者尝试了皮下注射二甲基亚砜（浓度为6.25%），并报告称在梯形肌附近注射后，“注射次日出现剧烈头痛，随后一周内头痛消失”，这表明存在一种类似神经疗法的重置机制。 <sup data-ref="865">865</sup>*

content.en: Migraines Reports
content.cn: 偏头痛报告

content.en: Migraine responses were more variable but included striking successes. One reader who had lived with chronic migraines since age 7 found that DMSO drops at the onset of aura caused the “aura disappeared and dissolved. No pain within a half hour. I don’t leave home without it now. Changed my life.” <sup data-ref="873">873</sup> A reader’s husband with migraines 2–3 times weekly for 30 years has had only one in 45 days since starting DMSO.<sup data-ref="874">874</sup> Another couple reported that for the wife’s 30+ years of daily migraines, DMSO “at least has an effect,” and “for the first time in many, many years I heard her say, my head is not hurting.” <sup data-ref="875">875</sup> while another reported “I’ve suffered my whole life and this is the first thing to take it away.” <sup data-ref="876">876</sup> A reader’s daughter with a migraine applied the DMSO roll-on to her forehead: “Minutes later she was literally snoring and woke up in the morning pain free.” <sup data-ref="877">877</sup>
content.cn: 针对偏头痛的反馈结果差异较大，但其中不乏令人瞩目的成功案例。一位自7岁起便饱受慢性偏头痛困扰的读者发现，在先兆出现时滴用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）滴剂，能让“先兆消失并消散。半小时内疼痛便消失了。 “现在我出门绝不会忘记带它。这彻底改变了我的生活。” <sup data-ref="877">877</sup> 另一位读者的丈夫曾每周发作2至3次偏头痛，持续30年之久，但在开始使用二甲基亚砜后，45天内仅发作过一次。 <sup data-ref="877">877</sup> 另一对夫妇表示，对于妻子30多年来的每日偏头痛，二甲基亚砜“至少起到了作用”，而且“许多许多年来，我第一次听到她说：‘我的头不疼了。’” <sup data-ref="877">877</sup> 还有一位读者表示：“我一辈子都在受苦，这是第一个能让我摆脱痛苦的方法。” <sup data-ref="877">877</sup> 一位患有偏头痛的读者女儿将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）滚珠涂抹在额头上：“几分钟后，她真的开始打鼾了，早上醒来时已经不再感到疼痛。” <sup data-ref="877">877</sup>

content.en: Multiple readers noted that catching the migraine early was essential for DMSO to work,<sup data-ref="873">873</sup>, <sup data-ref="878">878</sup>, <sup data-ref="879">879</sup> consistent with the clinical observation that migraines respond best to DMSO in the early stages.
content.cn: 多位读者指出，要使二甲基亚砜（DMSO）发挥疗效，及早发现偏头痛至关重要， <sup data-ref="873">873</sup> <sup data-ref="878">878</sup> <sup data-ref="879">879</sup> 这与临床观察结果一致，即偏头痛在早期阶段对二甲基亚砜的反应最佳。

content.en: Many other readers also reported migraine relief.<sup data-ref="880">880</sup>, <sup data-ref="881">881</sup>, <sup data-ref="878">878</sup>, <sup data-ref="882">882</sup>, <sup data-ref="883">883</sup>, <sup data-ref="884">884</sup>, <sup data-ref="885">885</sup>, <sup data-ref="886">886</sup>, <sup data-ref="887">887</sup>, <sup data-ref="888">888</sup>, <sup data-ref="889">889</sup>, <sup data-ref="890">890</sup>, <sup data-ref="891">891</sup>, <sup data-ref="892">892</sup>, <sup data-ref="891">891</sup>, <sup data-ref="876">876</sup>, <sup data-ref="893">893</sup>, <sup data-ref="885">885</sup>, <sup data-ref="885">885</sup> However, a few readers noted that DMSO at higher oral doses triggered headaches or migraines in them,<sup data-ref="894">894</sup>, <sup data-ref="863">863</sup>, <sup data-ref="895">895</sup> with one identifying a clear dose-response relationship and suspecting interaction with chronic sinus inflammation.<sup data-ref="894">894</sup> This is consistent with the biphasic dose response observed in the research literature.
content.cn: 许多其他读者也反映偏头痛症状得到了缓解。 <sup data-ref="894">894</sup> <sup data-ref="863">863</sup> <sup data-ref="895">895</sup> <sup data-ref="882">882</sup> <sup data-ref="883">883</sup> <sup data-ref="884">884</sup> <sup data-ref="885">885</sup> <sup data-ref="886">886</sup> <sup data-ref="887">887</sup> <sup data-ref="888">888</sup> <sup data-ref="889">889</sup> <sup data-ref="890">890</sup> <sup data-ref="891">891</sup> <sup data-ref="892">892</sup> <sup data-ref="891">891</sup> <sup data-ref="876">876</sup> <sup data-ref="893">893</sup> <sup data-ref="885">885</sup> <sup data-ref="885">885</sup> 然而，有少数读者指出，较高剂量的口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会引发他们的头痛或偏头痛， <sup data-ref="894">894</sup> <sup data-ref="863">863</sup> <sup data-ref="895">895</sup> 其中一人明确指出存在剂量-反应关系，并怀疑这与慢性鼻窦炎有关。 <sup data-ref="894">894</sup> 这与研究文献中观察到的双相剂量-反应关系一致。

content.en: *Note: many headaches are incorrectly categorized as migraines.
content.cn: 注：许多头痛被错误地归类为偏头痛。*

content.en: A New Relationship With Pain
content.cn: 与疼痛建立新的关系

content.en: In our society, pain is typically viewed as something to be feared and suppressed. However, I’ve long believed it should instead be seen as a necessary warning, since in many cases it serves as an overt or subtle indicator that something is wrong and an opportunity exists to improve your health.
content.cn: 在我们的社会中，疼痛通常被视为一种值得恐惧且需要压制的感受。然而，我长期以来一直认为，疼痛其实应当被视为一种必要的警示——因为在许多情况下，它会以明显或隐晦的方式提示身体出现了问题，同时也意味着改善健康状况的机会。

content.en: In this article, I’ve tried to touch upon the deep relationship between the health of the nervous system and the pain we experience, and to show that by healing nerves through giving them what they need, you can frequently eliminate pain rather than having to continually suppress it.
content.cn: 在本文中，我试图探讨神经系统健康与我们所经历的疼痛之间的深刻联系，并说明通过为神经提供所需养分来修复神经，往往可以消除疼痛，而无需一味地压制它。

content.en: Likewise, even in cases where full resolution is not possible, DMSO offers a way to dramatically improve these debilitating conditions and give patients a life that is not defined by pain or by the toxic medications they wish they could stop taking. I try very hard throughout these articles to avoid sensationalizing and to instead present the information in a balanced and objective way, but I must emphasize here that the suffering chronic pain patients experience is immense, to the point that many eventually take their own lives, and it is simply unconscionable that solutions like DMSO have been suppressed for over fifty years to protect the pain management industry.
content.cn: 同样，即使在无法完全治愈的情况下，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能显著改善这些令人衰弱的病症，让患者的生活不再受疼痛或那些他们渴望停用的有毒药物的束缚。 在撰写这些文章时，我竭力避免耸人听闻，而是以平衡、客观的方式呈现信息，但我必须在此强调：慢性疼痛患者所承受的痛苦是巨大的，甚至导致许多人最终选择结束自己的生命；而像二甲基亚砜（DMSO）这样的解决方案，为了维护疼痛管理产业的利益，竟被压制了五十多年，这简直是令人无法容忍的。

content.en: In the final part of this article, I will provide practical guidance on sourcing DMSO and detailed dosing protocols for each route of use (including intravenous), so that you and your doctor have the tools to use DMSO for the ailments you encounter. Additionally, I will cover:
content.cn: 在本文的最后一部分，我将就如何获取二甲基亚砜（DMSO）提供实用指南，并针对每种给药途径（包括静脉注射）详细说明用药方案，以便您和您的医生能够掌握使用DMSO治疗各类疾病的具体方法。此外，我还将介绍：

content.en: - Condition-specific treatment protocols for the conditions discussed throughout this article, such as the pain conditions covered here (e.g., headaches and migraines, trigeminal and post-herpetic neuralgia, and other forms of neuropathic pain) and the numerous neuropathies (including nerve palsies and compression neuropathies like carpal tunnel syndrome and sciatica), along with non-DMSO approaches that help these conditions.
content.cn: 针对本文所讨论的各类疾病（例如本文涉及的疼痛性疾病——如头痛和偏头痛、三叉神经痛和带状疱疹后神经痛，以及其他形式的神经病理性疼痛——以及多种神经病变，包括神经麻痹和压迫性神经病变，如腕管综合征和坐骨神经痛）的针对性治疗方案，以及有助于改善这些病情的非二甲基亚砜（DMSO）疗法。

content.en: - Protocols for the central nervous system conditions covered earlier in this series (e.g., strokes, Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, fatigue, brain fog, chronic stress, cognitive impairment, and developmental delay) and a wide range of spinal conditions (e.g., back or neck pain, disc issues, radiculopathies, and spinal cord injuries).
content.cn: 针对本系列前文所述的中枢神经系统疾病（例如：中风、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、疲劳、脑雾、慢性压力、认知障碍和发育迟缓）以及各类脊柱疾病（例如：背痛或颈痛、椎间盘问题、神经根病变和脊髓损伤）的治疗方案。

content.en: - Scar treatment and resources for individuals interested in obtaining neural therapy.
content.cn: 针对疤痕的治疗方法，以及面向有意接受神经疗法人士的相关资源。

content.en: - The specific agents that can be combined with DMSO to enhance its efficacy in the conditions detailed throughout this article (e.g., beyond how DMSO is applied for neuropathic pain affecting how well it works, a few agents have proven remarkably effective in combination with DMSO for it).
content.cn: 在本文所述的各种病症中，可与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用以增强其疗效的具体药物（例如，除了DMSO在神经病理性疼痛中的应用方式会影响其疗效外，还有几种药物已被证实与DMSO联合使用时对此类疼痛具有显著疗效）。

meta.title: How DMSO Heals the Brain and Transforms Neurology
meta.description: The extensive evidence behind DMSO's ability to treat 'incurable' neurological diseases — and how to use it
meta.label: 修复大脑与改变神经学

content.en: # How DMSO Heals the Brain and Transforms Neurology
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）如何修复大脑并改变神经学领域

content.en: The extensive evidence behind DMSO's ability to treat 'incurable' neurological diseases — and how to use it
content.cn: 关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够治疗“不治之症”的神经系统疾病这一观点的丰富证据——以及其使用方法

content.en: **Story at a Glance:故事概要：**

- **DMSO is an “umbrella remedy” capable of treating a wide range of challenging ailments due to its combination of therapeutic properties (e.g., improving circulation, reducing inflammation, protecting cells from a myriad of otherwise lethal stressors, and reviving dying cells).
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是一种“万能疗法”，由于其兼具多种治疗特性（例如：改善血液循环、减轻炎症、保护细胞免受各种原本致命的应激因素的伤害，以及复苏濒死细胞），因此能够治疗多种棘手的疾病。**

content.en: - **These properties make DMSO uniquely suited to treat “incurable” neurological disorders, and in conjunction with forgotten research on the effects of microcirculatory impairments, reshape our understanding of the causes of neurological (and psychiatric) diseases.
content.cn: 这些特性使二甲基亚砜（DMSO）特别适合用于治疗“无法治愈”的神经系统疾病；再加上关于微循环障碍影响的那些被遗忘的研究，这些发现正在重塑我们对神经系统（及精神）疾病病因的理解。**

content.en: - **DMSO has shown remarkable promise for cognitive impairment, brain fog, and memory loss from a wide range of causes (e.g., aging, vascular disease, anesthesia, post-COVID or pharmaceutical poisoning), along with improving sleep quality and dream vividness — often by resolving the pain, breathing difficulties, or neurological conditions (e.g., restless leg syndrome) that were preventing restorative sleep.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在改善由多种原因（例如衰老、血管疾病、麻醉、新冠肺炎后遗症或药物中毒）导致的认知功能障碍、脑雾和记忆力减退方面展现出显著的潜力，同时还能改善睡眠质量和梦境的生动性——这通常是通过缓解阻碍恢复性睡眠的疼痛、呼吸困难或神经系统疾病（例如不宁腿综合征）来实现的。**

content.en: - **Extensive data supports DMSO’s use for the major neurodegenerative diseases — including Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, ALS, Huntington’s, and multiple sclerosis — and protein misfolding diseases such as prion disorders and Niemann-Pick disease, where DMSO’s ability to act as a chemical chaperone (stabilizing proteins and dissolving toxic aggregates) and augment cranial drainage is particularly relevant.
content.cn: 大量数据表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可用于治疗主要的神经退行性疾病——包括帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、亨廷顿病和多发性硬化症——以及蛋白质错误折叠类疾病，如朊病毒病和尼曼-皮克病。在这些疾病中，DMSO作为化学伴侣（稳定蛋白质并溶解有毒聚集物）以及促进颅内引流的能力尤为重要。**

content.en: - **Numerous psychiatric conditions (e.g., schizophrenia, depression, anxiety, and PTSD) have responded to DMSO, as have seizures and epilepsy, movement disorders, encephalitis, myasthenia gravis, and hydrocephalus.
content.cn: 许多精神疾病（例如精神分裂症、抑郁症、焦虑症和创伤后应激障碍）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有反应，癫痫发作、癫痫、运动障碍、脑炎、重症肌无力及脑积水也是如此。**

content.en: - **DMSO has also produced striking developmental improvements in children with Down syndrome across multiple clinical studies, along with many other neurodevelopmental disorders.
content.cn: 在多项临床研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）不仅对唐氏综合征患儿，而且对许多其他神经发育障碍患儿，都产生了显著的发育改善效果。**

content.en: - **This article will synopsize the extensive data demonstrating DMSO’s efficacy for CNS neurological diseases (approximately 2000 studies and 200 pertinent reader testimonials), share pertinent (non-DMSO) discoveries we’ve made about neurological diseases over the years, and then conclude with practical guidance on DMSO protocols and complementary approaches that also aid in the treatment of common neurological disorders.
content.cn: 本文将概述大量证明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对中枢神经系统（CNS）神经系统疾病疗效的数据（约2000项研究和200则相关读者反馈），分享我们多年来在神经系统疾病领域所获得的相关（非DMSO）研究成果，最后就DMSO治疗方案以及有助于治疗常见神经系统疾病的辅助疗法提供实用指导。**

content.en: DMSO has remarkable therapeutic utility across a wide range of challenging conditions yet is largely unknown. Recognizing this, I spent the last two years compiling the data which shows DMSO treats a wide array of conditions including [lung issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-heals-the-lungs-and-cures-chronic-35a) (e.g. COPD and Asthma), [skin issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-revolutionizes-skin-care-and) (including hair loss), [many different types of pain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for), [arthritis](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune), [tissue injury](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) (e.g., sprains or burns), [eye issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-heals-the-eyes-and-transforms) (e.g., vision loss or dry eyes), [autoimmune disorders](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune), [dental issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-cures-eye-ear-nose-throat), [gastrointestinal diseases](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-gut-and-cures), [infections](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-transforms-the-treatment-of), and [cancers](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms) (along with how DMSO’s efficacy can be further enhanced by [combining it with pharmaceuticals](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/therapeutic-dmso-combinations-revolutionize) or [natural therapies](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-mixtures-transform-natural-medicine)).
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在治疗多种棘手疾病方面具有显著的疗效，却鲜为人知。意识到这一点，我在过去两年里整理了相关数据，这些数据表明DMSO可治疗多种疾病，包括肺部疾病（如 慢性阻塞性肺病和哮喘）、皮肤问题（包括脱发）、多种类型的疼痛、关节炎、组织损伤（例如扭伤或烧伤）、眼部问题（例如视力丧失或干眼症）、自身免疫性疾病、牙科问题、胃肠道疾病、感染以及癌症（同时还包括如何通过将二甲基亚砜与药物或天然疗法结合使用来进一步增强其疗效）。
